jobs.description:
Mission

Au sein de l’unité EPFL-FR Building2050, la personne recrutée contribue à la structuration et à la valorisation des données numériques issues de la construction du Smart Living Lab (SLL), ainsi qu’à leur mise à disposition au moyen d’outils numériques adaptés.

La fonction implique de contribuer à la gestion, à la validation et à la maintenance des données numériques liées au BIM (Building Information Modeling) et au suivi de chantier, ainsi que d’assurer le soutien numérique et administratif de l’interface DARE (Digital Assets for Research Experiments) — qui centralise l’accès des occupant·es-chercheur·es aux données, services et ressources du bâtiment. Elle inclut également la création de tableaux de bord et de supports audiovisuels pour la communication et la valorisation des activités de l’unité.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Gestion des données numériques, des modèles BIM et des outils numériques

• Mise en place et suivi du processus de validation des données numériques transmises par l’entreprise totale dans le cadre de la soumission BIM et de la charte chantier, incluant la vérification des maquettes BIM, de leurs paramètres, et de la documentation technique relative aux matériaux et au chantier.

• Gestion des modèles numériques utilisés pour la recherche et le suivi du bâtiment.

• Support sur l'automatisation de tâches répétitives

• Support à l’actualisation mensuelle des données du projet SUIVI (suivi numérique du chantier).

• Contribution au développement du jumeau numérique par la mise en relation des données du monitoring du bâtiment avec les modèles et ressources numériques disponibles (BIM, tour virtuel, etc.).

• Maintenance des interfaces web de l’unité et du bâtiment.

• Identification et évaluation de logiciels, d’outils et de solutions numériques pour améliorer les fonctionnalités de l’unité et les services proposés aux chercheur.es.

Développement, maintenance et amélioration de l’interface DARE

• Développement et maintenance de la page d’accueil de l’interface DARE (Digital Assets for Research Experiments), qui centralise l’accès aux services, outils et ressources numériques développés par l’équipe IT-OT (Information & Operational Technologies) de la PL-MTI au service de la recherche.

• Amélioration progressive des fonctionnalités et de l’ergonomie du DARE, en fonction des besoins identifiés et des ressources budgétaires disponibles.

Communication et supports audiovisuels du SLL

• Production de tableaux de bord et de supports audiovisuels pour la communication, le suivi et la valorisation des activités du SLL.

• Contribution à la communication du SLL, notamment par la mise à jour des contenus web.

Profil

• Formation supérieure en informatique et en gestion de bases de données, de niveau CFC, ES, HES/EPF, ou formation jugée équivalente.

• Connaissances en BIM, en maquettes numériques et en gestion de données de construction.

• Maîtrise des outils web et de communication numérique.

• Compétences pour la création de tableaux de bord à l’aide d’outils open source (exemple Grafana, Influx).

• Compétences en développement et maintenance d’interfaces web.

• Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes IT-OT et de recherche.

• Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l’organisation.

• Français courant ; anglais un atout.

Nous offrons

• Une ambiance de travail conviviale et stimulante.

• Un environnement de travail de qualité.

• L’opportunité de participer à des projets exigeants et variés.

• Toutes les prestations sociales d’une grande entreprise.

• L’opportunité de contribuer au développement d’un campus dynamique, au cœur de missions d’éducation, de recherche et d’innovation.

Type de contrat : CDD

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

Within the EPFL-FR Building2050 unit, the recruited person contributes to the structuring and valorisation of the digital data resulting from the construction of the Smart Living Lab (SLL) and to their availability using appropriate digital tools.

The function involves contributing to the management, validation and maintenance of digital data related to the BIM (Building Information Modeling) and site monitoring, as well as providing digital and administrative support for the DARE (Digital Assets for Research Experiments) interface, which centralizes access to building data, services and resources for researchers. It also includes the creation of dashboards and audio-visual media for communication and valorisation of unit activities.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Digital Data Management, BIM Models and Digital Tools

• Implementation and monitoring of the process of validation of the digital data transmitted by the total company as part of the BIM submission and the site charter, including verification of the BIM models, their parameters, and technical documentation relating to materials and the site.

• Management of digital models used for building research and monitoring.

• Support on the automation of repetitive tasks

• Support for monthly updating of the SUIVI project data (digital monitoring of the project site).

• Contribution to the development of the digital twin by linking building monitoring data with available digital models and resources (BIM, virtual tower, etc.).

• Maintenance of unit and building web interfaces.

• Identification and evaluation of software, tools and digital solutions to improve unit functionality and services for researchers.

Development, maintenance and improvement of the DARE interface

• Development and maintenance of the DARE (Digital Assets for Research Experiments) interface home page, which centralizes access to digital services, tools and resources developed by PL-MTI's IT-OT (Information & Operational Technologies) research team.

• Gradual improvement of DARE functionality and ergonomics, based on identified needs and available budgetary resources.

Communication and audiovisual media of SLL

• Production of dashboards and audiovisual material for the communication, monitoring and exploitation of SLL activities.

• Contribution to the communication of SLL, in particular by updating web content.

Profile

• Advanced training in computer science and database management, at the CFC, ES, HES/EPF level, or equivalent.

• Knowledge of BIM, digital models and construction data management.

• Mastery of web and digital communication tools.

• Skills for creating dashboards using open source tools (e.g. Grafana, Inlux).

• Skills in web interface development and maintenance.

• Ability to collaborate with IT-OT and research teams.

• Autonomy, rigor, sense of organization.

• Current French; English an asset.

We offer

• A friendly and stimulating working atmosphere.

• A quality working environment.

• The opportunity to participate in demanding and varied projects.

• All social benefits of a large enterprise.

• The opportunity to contribute to the development of a dynamic campus, at the heart of educational, research and innovation missions.

Information

Occupancy rate: 80% to 100%

Type of contract: CSD

Duration: 1 year

Mission

The Chair of International Finance (SFI-LL) at the College of Management of Technology (CDM) at EPFL invites applications for a postdoctoral position starting in June 2027.

We are seeking a young scholar whose research interests lie in open-economy macroeconomics and/or macro-finance, including banking regulation.

CDM is a center of excellence for research and education in economics, finance and management. Research at SFI-LL falls broadly in international macroeconomics, with a focus on fiscal and monetary policy, macro-finance and banking regulation. The emphasis is on rigorous modeling, data-driven analysis and numerical evaluation.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

The successful candidate is expected to:

• Develop a research program in the broad areas of interest of the chair

• Collaborate in the existing research programs

• Contribute to the educational programs

Profil

• PhD in Economics or Finance

• Background in open-economy macro economics, macro-finance and/or banking regulation

• Strong computational and analytical skills

• Independent, creative, and solution-oriented

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

Nous offrons

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website ( Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits )

• An environment strongly conducive to academic research

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply, in pdf format:

• A cover letter (up to 2 pages)

• A curriculum vitae

• A research statement (up to 3 pages)

Mission

Le laboratoire de recherche photovoltaïque (PVlab) est spécialisé dans la fabrication et la fiabilité de cellules et de panneaux solaires. Afin de renforcer son équipe, le PVlab recherche un.e technicien.ne ou un.e ingénieur.e motivé.e pour soutenir la recherche dans l’énergie renouvelable. En tant que membre de l’équipe technique, vous travaillerez au support et au développement des équipements scientifiques du laboratoire et contribuerez au développement de nouvelles technologies pour le photovoltaïque.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Au sein de notre équipe, vous apporterez un soutien technique à différents projets. Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :

• Support technique aux collaborateurs du groupe

• Entretien des équipements scientifiques (PVD, PECVD, etc..)

• Analyse des défauts des équipements et correction de ceux-ci

• Maintenance des infrastructures du laboratoire (gaz spéciaux, eau DI)

• Développement d’équipements pour la recherche

Profil

Vous êtes un·e professionnel·le motivé·e, fiable et curieux·se, qui apprécie l’apprentissage de nouvelles techniques et le travail au sein d’une équipe de recherche collaborative. Vous adoptez une approche critique dans votre travail et êtes capable de travailler de manière autonome une fois formé·e.

Vous devez disposer des qualifications suivantes :

• Une formation en électronique, automation ou mécanique et des connaissances dans les autres domaines

• Un niveau de formation de technicien ES ou d’ingénieur HES

• La capacité à organiser votre travail, à gérer plusieurs tâches de façon autonome

• Une maitrise de l’anglais, niveau B2 ou supérieur

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants constituerait un atout :

• Technique du vide

• Programmation de PLC

• Hautes fréquences (HF et VHF)

Une formation aux techniques mentionnées ci-dessus sera proposée dans le cadre de la prise de fonction. Nous accordons une importance particulière à la motivation, la fiabilité, la curiosité ainsi qu’à l’esprit d’équipe et à la volonté de contribuer activement aux activités du laboratoire.

Nous offrons

À l'EPFL, nous avons la conviction que chacun et chacune peut accomplir de grandes choses lorsqu'il ou elle évolue dans un environnement bienveillant, respectueux et propice à la réussite. En rejoignant notre institution, vous contribuerez à façonner l'avenir de la société grâce à l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation.

• D’excellentes conditions de travail au sein d’une équipe internationale, multidisciplinaire et à la pointe de la technologie, avec un accès à des infrastructures de haut niveau

• Un groupe de recherche jeune, dynamique, flexible et stimulant

• Une rémunération et des prestations sociales compétitives

• Un environnement culturel riche, des cours de formation continue, l’accès à ces infrastructures sportives, un abonnement CFF demi-tarif.

Au-delà de votre activité professionnelle, nos campus accueillent une communauté dynamique dans un cadre unique, porté par de nombreuses initiatives en faveur de l’égalité, de l’inclusion, de la diversité, du bien-être et de la durabilité. Tout au long de l’année, un programme varié d’activités culturelles, sportives et communautaires vient également renforcer la vie du campus.

Découvrez nos conditions d’emploi et les avantages offerts à nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs.

Informations

Seules les candidatures soumises via la plateforme en ligne sont prises en compte.

Sei un professionista motivato, affidabile e curioso che apprezza imparare nuove tecniche e lavorare in un team di ricerca collaborativo. Si prende un approccio critico al vostro lavoro e sono in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente una volta addestrato.

• Formazione in elettronica, automazione o meccanica e conoscenza in altri settori

• Capacità di organizzare il vostro lavoro, gestire più attività indipendentemente

Esperienza o conoscenza in una o più delle seguenti aree sarebbe un bene:

In EPFL, siamo convinti che tutti possano realizzare grandi cose quando si evolve in un ambiente attento, rispettoso e di successo. Unendo la nostra istituzione, vi aiuterà a plasmare il futuro della società attraverso l'istruzione, la ricerca e l'innovazione.

Mission

The photovoltaic research laboratory (PVlab) specializes in the manufacture and reliability of solar cells and panels. To strengthen its team, the PVlab is looking for a motivated technician or engineer to support research in renewable energy. As a member of the technical team, you will work to support and develop the laboratory's scientific equipment and contribute to the development of new photovoltaic technologies.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Within our team, you will provide technical support to various projects. Your responsibilities will include:

• Technical support to the group's employees

• Maintenance of scientific equipment (PVD, PECVD, etc.)

• Equipment fault analysis and correction

• Maintenance of laboratory infrastructure (special gases, DI water)

• Development of research equipment

Profile

You are a motivated, reliable and curious professional who appreciates learning new techniques and working in a collaborative research team. You take a critical approach to your work and are able to work independently once trained.

You must have the following qualifications:

• Training in electronics, automation or mechanics and knowledge in other fields

• A level of ES technician or HES engineer training

• Ability to organize your work, manage multiple tasks independently

• English mastery, level B2 or higher

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas would be an asset:

• Vacuum technology

• PLC Programming

• High frequencies (HF and VHF)

Training in the above-mentioned techniques will be offered in the context of taking up office. We attach particular importance to motivation, reliability, curiosity, team spirit and the willingness to actively contribute to laboratory activities.

We offer

At EPFL, we are convinced that everyone can accomplish great things when he or she evolves in a caring, respectful and successful environment. By joining our institution, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation.

• Excellent working conditions within an international, multidisciplinary and state-of-the-art team, with access to high-level infrastructure

• A young, dynamic, flexible and stimulating research group

• Competitive pay and social benefits

• A rich cultural environment, continuing training courses, access to these sports infrastructures, a half-tariff SBB subscription.

Beyond your professional activity, our campuses welcome a vibrant community within a unique framework, driven by many initiatives to promote equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability. Throughout the year, a varied program of cultural, sports and community activities also strengthens campus life.

Discover our terms and conditions of employment and the benefits offered to our employees.

vous participerez à des projets de recherche innovants dans le domaine des neurosciences et des neurotechnologies.

Vous serez principalement responsable de la réalisation et du suivi d'expériences comportementales sur des modèles rongeurs, notamment dans le cadre de recherches sur les lésions de la moelle épinière et la récupération des fonctions motrices.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les scientifiques et les étudiants du laboratoire, dans un environnement multidisciplinaire utilisant des technologies de pointe.

• Réaliser des expériences comportementales sur des rongeurs, comprenant leur entraînement et l'enregistrement de leurs performances lors de différentes tâches motrices.

• Assurer la réhabilitation quotidienne de rongeurs présentant des lésions de la moelle épinière, notamment à l'aide de dispositifs robotiques, de stimulations électriques et d'approches pharmacologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des animaux et veiller à leur bien-être tout au long des protocoles expérimentaux.

• Participer à la gestion et au suivi des lignées transgéniques du laboratoire.

• Apporter un soutien technique aux scientifiques et aux étudiants dans la réalisation de leurs projets de recherche.

• Bonnes connaissances et aisance dans la manipulation des animaux de laboratoire, en particulier des rongeurs.

• Intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale et les neurosciences.

• Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.

• Personne patiente, rigoureuse, flexible et organisée, disposant d'un bon sens de l'observation.

• Bonnes capacités relationnelles, esprit d'équipe et aptitude à s'adapter à un environnement de recherche multidisciplinaire.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Breve descrizione

La nostra missione è quella di progettare e sviluppare interventi innovativi per ripristinare le funzioni motorie in seguito ai danni del sistema nervoso centrale, in particolare del midollo spinale, e di tradurre i nostri risultati scientifici in applicazioni cliniche che possono migliorare la qualità della vita delle persone con disabilità motorie.

Per saperne di più sulla nostra missione e le nostre attività di ricerca, visita .NeuroRestore: www.neurorestore.swiss .

Missione

L'unità del professor Grégoire Courtine sta cercando un tecnico di comportamento animale per unirsi al suo team di ricerca a Ginevra.

parteciperai a progetti di ricerca innovativi nel campo delle neuroscienze e delle neurotecnologie.

Sarete principalmente responsabili per condurre e monitorare esperimenti comportamentali sui modelli roditori, tra cui la ricerca sulle lesioni del midollo spinale e il recupero delle funzioni motorie.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con scienziati di laboratorio e studenti in un ambiente multidisciplinare utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia.

Principali compiti e responsabilità

• Condurre esperimenti comportamentali sui roditori, tra cui la loro formazione e registrare le loro prestazioni durante varie attività motorie.

• Assicurare la riabilitazione quotidiana di roditori con lesioni del midollo spinale, compresi dispositivi robotici, stimolazione elettrica e approcci farmacologici.

• Monitorare gli animali e garantire il loro benessere durante i protocolli sperimentali.

• Partecipa alla gestione e al monitoraggio delle linee transgenice di laboratorio.

• Fornire supporto tecnico a scienziati e studenti nella realizzazione dei loro progetti di ricerca.

• Contribuire all'organizzazione, il corretto funzionamento e la manutenzione generale del laboratorio.

Profilo

• Formazione in fisiologia, neuroscienze, biologia o campo equivalente.

• Buona conoscenza e facilità nella gestione di animali da laboratorio, in particolare roditori.

• Interessi nella ricerca sperimentale e neuroscienze.

• Buon comando di francese e inglese.

• Una persona paziente, rigorosa, flessibile e organizzata con un buon senso di osservazione.

• Buone relazioni, spirito di squadra e capacità di adattarsi a un ambiente di ricerca multidisciplinare.

Offriamo

• Un contratto fisso di un anno, rinnovabile.

• Un ambiente di ricerca stimolante, dinamico e multidisciplinare.

• L'opportunità di contribuire a progetti scientifici innovativi nel campo delle neurotecnologie e del recupero dei motori.

• Chiudi la collaborazione con team scientifici che utilizzano tecnologie avanzate.

• Condizioni di lavoro e remunerazione secondo gli standard EPFL.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Short description

Our mission is to design and develop innovative interventions to restore motor functions following central nervous system damage, especially spinal cord damage, and to translate our scientific findings into clinical applications that can improve the quality of life of people with motor impairments.

To learn more about our mission and our research activities, please visit .NeuroRestore: www.neurorestore.swiss .

Mission

Professor Grégoire Courtine's unit is looking for an animal behaviour technician to join his research team in Geneva.

you will participate in innovative research projects in the field of neurosciences and neurotechnologies.

You will be primarily responsible for conducting and monitoring behavioural experiments on rodent models, including research on spinal cord lesions and recovery of motor functions.

You will work closely with laboratory scientists and students in a multidisciplinary environment using cutting-edge technologies.

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Conduct behavioral experiments on rodents, including their training and recording their performance during various motor tasks.

• Ensure the daily rehabilitation of rodents with spinal cord lesions, including robotic devices, electrical stimulation and pharmacological approaches.

• Monitor animals and ensure their well-being throughout the experimental protocols.

• Participate in the management and monitoring of laboratory transgenic lines.

• Provide technical support to scientists and students in carrying out their research projects.

• Contribute to the organization, proper functioning and general maintenance of the laboratory.

Profile

• Training in physiology, neuroscience, biology or an equivalent field.

• Good knowledge and ease in handling laboratory animals, especially rodents.

• Interest in experimental research and neuroscience.

• Good command of French and English.

• A patient, rigorous, flexible and organized person with a common sense of observation.

• Good relationships, team spirit and ability to adapt to a multidisciplinary research environment.

We offer

• A one-year fixed-term contract, renewable.

• A stimulating, dynamic and multidisciplinary research environment.

• The opportunity to contribute to innovative scientific projects in the field of neurotechnology and motor recovery.

• Close collaboration with scientific teams using advanced technologies.

• Working conditions and remuneration in accordance with EPFL standards.

Discover our terms and conditions of employment and the benefits offered to our employees.

Information

Effective date: 1 March 2027

Occupancy rate: 80%

Type of contract: CSD, renewable

Duration: One year

Reference: Interested persons are invited to submit their applications, including a CV, a cover letter and copies of their diplomas and certificates, via the EPFL recruitment platform.

​
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzbeschreibung

Unsere Mission ist es, innovative Interventionen zu entwerfen und zu entwickeln, um die motorischen Funktionen nach Schäden des zentralen Nervensystems, insbesondere Rückenmarkschäden, wiederherzustellen und unsere wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in klinische Anwendungen umzusetzen, die die Lebensqualität von Menschen mit motorischen Beeinträchtigungen verbessern können.

Um mehr über unsere Mission und unsere Forschungsaktivitäten zu erfahren, besuchen Sie bitte .NeuroRestore: www.neurorestore.swiss .

Mission

Die Abteilung von Professor Grégoire Courtine sucht einen Techniker für Tierverhalten, der sich seinem Forschungsteam in Genf anschließen soll.

Sie beteiligen sich an innovativen Forschungsprojekten im Bereich Neurowissenschaften und Neurotechnologien.

Sie sind in erster Linie für die Durchführung und Überwachung von Verhaltensexperimenten an Nagetiermodellen verantwortlich, einschließlich der Erforschung von Rückenmarksläsionen und der Wiederherstellung motorischer Funktionen.

Sie arbeiten eng mit Laborwissenschaftlern und Studenten in einem multidisziplinären Umfeld mit innovativen Technologien zusammen.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie Verhaltensexperimente an Nagetieren durch, einschließlich ihres Trainings und der Aufzeichnung ihrer Leistung bei verschiedenen motorischen Aufgaben.

• Gewährleistung der täglichen Rehabilitation von Nagetieren mit Rückenmarksläsionen, einschließlich Robotergeräten, elektrischer Stimulation und pharmakologischer Ansätze.

• Überwachung der Tiere und Gewährleistung ihres Wohlbefindens während der gesamten Versuchsprotokolle.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Verwaltung und Überwachung von Labor-transgenen Linien.

• Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung für Wissenschaftler und Studenten bei der Durchführung ihrer Forschungsprojekte.

• Beitrag zur Organisation, zum ordnungsgemäßen Funktionieren und zur allgemeinen Wartung des Labors.

Profil

• Ausbildung in Physiologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biologie oder einem gleichwertigen Bereich.

• Gute Kenntnisse und einfache Handhabung von Labortieren, insbesondere Nagetieren.

• Interesse an experimenteller Forschung und Neurowissenschaften.

• Gute Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch.

• Eine geduldige, strenge, flexible und organisierte Person mit einem gesunden Beobachtungssinn.

• Gute Beziehungen, Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, sich an ein multidisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld anzupassen.

Wir bieten

• Ein einjähriger befristeter Vertrag, verlängerbar.

• Ein stimulierendes, dynamisches und multidisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld.

• Die Möglichkeit, zu innovativen wissenschaftlichen Projekten auf dem Gebiet der Neurotechnologie und der motorischen Erholung beizutragen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Teams unter Einsatz fortschrittlicher Technologien.

• Arbeitsbedingungen und Vergütung nach EPFL-Standards.

Entdecken Sie unsere Arbeitsbedingungen und die Leistungen, die unseren Mitarbeitern angeboten werden.

Information

Datum des Inkrafttretens: 1. März 2027

Belegungsquote: 80%

Art des Vertrags: Zentralverwahrer, erneuerbar

Laufzeit: ein Jahr

Referenz: Interessierte Personen werden aufgefordert, ihre Bewerbungen, einschließlich eines Lebenslaufs, eines Anschreibens und Kopien ihrer Diplome und Zeugnisse, über die EPFL-Rekrutierungsplattform einzureichen.

Mission

An on-site, postdoc position is available at EPFL (Lausanne, Switzerland) in the group of Prof. Martin Hairer.

Main duties and responsibilities

You will be collaborating on research projects in or around the general areas of stochastic PDEs / probabilistic aspects of QFT.
The precise research topic(s) will be discussed with the successful candidate depending on their background and affinities.
There will also be plenty of scope for the researcher to follow their own research interests.
Candidates will be expected to actively contribute to all departmental activities.

Profile

•
A formal requirement for the position is a PhD in mathematics,

•
A background in probability theory / stochastic analysis / PDE theory would be extremely beneficial.

•
Proficiency in English is required.

We offer

• A stimulating work environment in a world class research group set in beautiful surroundings.

• A very competitive salary.

• We encourage personal initiative and independent research tasks related to the candidate’s interests.

•
A brief cover / motivation letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

•
A curriculum vitae including a full list of publications.

•
A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).

•
Three reference letters to be sent by referees to stochastics [ at]epfl.ch with subject: Reference letter PROPDE Posdoc + Your Name)

The lab of biomedical microfluidics (LBMM; www.epfl.ch/labs/lbmm ) at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL), is looking for postdocs with a primary training in single-cell biology, next generation sequencing or antibody discovery. Experience in droplet-microfluidics, including use of commercial devices such as the 10X Genomics platform is beneficial, but not absolutely crucial. LBMM has already developed powerful technology platforms in the field of biomedicine and genomics over the past years, also leading to the establishment of two startup companies ( www.veraxa.com and www.thera-me.ch ).

Having a comprehensive microﬂuidic toolbox at hand (and expanding it continuously), we are now inviting applications for highly multiplexed single-cell RNAseq-based antibody discovery. The idea behind this project is to exploit transcriptomic data sets for the discovery of new therapeutic antibodies.

The lab has a very translational focus, running a tech development lab on the EPFL campus and a translational lab in the AGORA cancer research center (with direct access to patient material). Furthermore, a strong network of clinical partners in Europe and the US has been established.

The successful candidate will closely interact with experts in microfluidics and bioinformatics, while spearheading the above project.

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student in the Laloui Group at EPFL inLausanne. The group brings expertise in geomaterials and their mechanical behaviour to research at theinterface of material science and engineering applications.

You will work on the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project “DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems”, conducted in collaboration between Dr. Dimitrios Terzis, Senior Scientist in the LalouiGroup at EPFL, and co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger of the Chair of Digital Building Technologies at ETHZurich. The project investigates how biologically driven mineralization can transform demolition and excavationmaterials into materials suitable for digital fabrication under ambient conditions.

Digital fabrication methods, including extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying, offer opportunities to controlmaterial placement and curing, create complex geometries and reduce material consumption. Integratingbiomineralization into pumpable, extrudable and sprayable granular materials remains largely unexplored. ThisPhD will investigate the coupled biogeochemical, rheological and mechanical mechanisms governing particledeposition, mineral precipitation and hardening.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Take full responsibility for your dissertation and the progress of your research.

• Conduct research in close collaboration with project partners at EPFL and ETH Zurich and, whereapplicable, industry partners.

• Design and execute experiments, and analyze and interpret experimental results.

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present your findings at internationalconferences.

• Participate in teaching and supervise student projects.

More specifically, within this project, you will:

• Investigate the rheology and processability of granular materials, including yield stress, plastic viscosity,thixotropy, water content, ageing and particle interactions.

• Study microbial activity and biologically driven mineral precipitation, and determine how evolving mineralphases affect mechanical hardening and material performance.

• Characterize the coupling between biogeochemical reactions, rheological properties and mechanicalbehaviour over space and time.

• Connect experimental findings to extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying in collaboration with thedigital fabrication team at ETH Zurich.

Profile

• An MSc degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering or aclosely related discipline.

• A background in mechanics and the strength of solid materials, or materials science applied to the builtenvironment, is particularly welcome.

• Experience in rheology, granular or cementitious materials, experimental mechanics, materialcharacterization, geomechanics, mineralogy, or organic and inorganic chemistry is an advantage.Expertise across all these fields is neither expected nor required.

• Interest in experimental and interdisciplinary research, and in translating fundamental physical andchemical understanding into new construction technologies.

• Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team across disciplines and institutions.

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eagerness to learn, good organizational skills and rigor in experimentalwork.

• A high level of motivation for academic research.

• Fluency in English is essential.

Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Stiamo offrendo una posizione impegnativa come uno studente di dottorato a tempo pieno (100%) nel Gruppo Laloui all'EPFL di Losanna. Il gruppo offre competenze in geomateriali e il loro comportamento meccanico alla ricerca nell’ambito delle applicazioni di scienza e ingegneria dei materiali.

Lavorerai sul progetto finanziato dalla Fondazione nazionale svizzera per la scienza (SNSF) “DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems”, condotto in collaborazione con Dr. Dimitrios Terzis, Senior Scientist in the LalouiGroup in EPFL, e co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger della Cattedra di Digital Building Technologies a ETHZurich. Il progetto indaga su come la mineralizzazione biologicamente guidata può trasformare demolizione e materiali di scavo in materiali adatti alla fabbricazione digitale in condizioni ambientali.

I metodi di fabbricazione digitale, tra cui la stampa 3D di estrusione e la spruzzatura robotica, offrono la possibilità di controllare il posizionamento e la polimerizzazione dei materiali, creare geometrie complesse e ridurre il consumo di materiale. Integrare la biomineralizzazione in materiali granulari pompabili, estrusi e spruzzabili rimane in gran parte inesplorati. Questo PhD studierà i meccanismi biogeochimici accoppiati, reologici e meccanici che disciplinano la particelladeposizione, le precipitazioni minerali e l'indurimento.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Come studente di dottorato, ci si aspetta di:

• Assumere la piena responsabilità per la vostra tesi e il progresso della vostra ricerca.

• Condurre la ricerca in stretta collaborazione con i partner di progetto dell’EPFL e dell’ETH di Zurigo e, laddove applicabile, i partner del settore.

• Progettare ed eseguire esperimenti, analizzare e interpretare i risultati sperimentali.

• Scrivere articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed e presentare i vostri risultati in conferenze internazionali.

• Partecipare all'insegnamento e supervisionare i progetti degli studenti.

Più specificamente, all'interno di questo progetto, si:

• Indagare la reologia e la processabilità dei materiali granulari, tra cui lo stress del rendimento, la viscosità della plastica, la sestatropia, il contenuto dell'acqua, l'invecchiamento e le interazioni delle particelle.

• Studiare l'attività microbica e la precipitazione minerale biologicamente guidata e determinare come le fasi minerali in evoluzione influiscono sull'indurimento meccanico e sulle prestazioni dei materiali.

• Caratterizzare l'accoppiamento tra reazioni biogeochimiche, proprietà reologiche e comportamento meccanico nello spazio e nel tempo.

• Collegare i risultati sperimentali alla stampa 3D e alla spruzzatura robotica in collaborazione con il team di fabbricazione digitale di ETH Zurich.

Profilo

• Laurea in Ingegneria Civile, Scienza dei Materiali e Ingegneria, Ingegneria Chimica o disciplina strettamente correlata.

• Un background in meccanica e la forza dei materiali solidi, o scienza dei materiali applicata all'ambiente costruito, è particolarmente gradito.

• L'esperienza in reologia, materiali granulari o cementizi, meccanica sperimentale, materialcharacterization, geomeccanica, mineralogia, o chimica organica e inorganica è un vantaggio. La competenza in tutti questi campi non è prevista né richiesta.

• Interessi nella ricerca sperimentale e interdisciplinare, e nel tradurre la comprensione fisica e chimica fondamentale nelle nuove tecnologie di costruzione.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e disponibilità a lavorare come parte di un team di discipline e istituzioni.

• Entusiasmo, curiosità scientifica, desiderio di imparare, buone capacità organizzative e rigore nel lavoro sperimentale.

• Un alto livello di motivazione per la ricerca accademica.

• La fluidità in inglese è essenziale.

Offriamo

Unendo la nostra comunità, contribuirete a plasmare il futuro della società attraverso l’istruzione, la ricerca e l’innovazione. Combinato con modi flessibili di lavorare e condizioni di lavoro interessanti, tessiamo a creare un ambiente in cui tutti possono contribuire, crescere e fare la differenza.

Oltre al lavoro, i nostri campus ospitano una vivace comunità e un ambiente unico, arricchiti da iniziative che promuovono l’uguaglianza, l’inclusione, la diversità, il benessere e la sostenibilità, nonché da un coinvolgente programma di attività culturali, sportive e comunitarie durante tutto l’anno.

Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student in the Laloui Group at EPFL inLausanne. The group brings expertise in geomaterials and their mechanical behaviour to research at theinterface of material science and engineering applications.

You will work on the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project “DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems”, conducted in collaboration between Dr. Dimitrios Terzis, Senior Scientist in the LalouiGroup at EPFL, and co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger of the Chair of Digital Building Technologies at ETHZurich. The project investigates how biologically driven mineralization can transform demolition and excavationmaterials into materials suitable for digital fabrication under ambient conditions.

Digital fabrication methods, including extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying, offer opportunities to controlmaterial placement and curing, create complex geometries and reduce material consumption. Integratingbiomineralization into pumpable, extrudable and sprayable granular materials remains largely unexplored. ThisPhD will investigate the coupled biogeochemical, rheological and mechanical mechanisms governing particledeposition, mineral precipitation and hardening.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Take full responsibility for your dissertation and the progress of your research.

• Conduct research in close collaboration with project partners at EPFL and ETH Zurich and, whereapplicable, industry partners.

• Design and execute experiments, and analyze and interpret experimental results.

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present your findings at internationalconferences.

• Participate in teaching and supervise student projects.

More specifically, within this project, you will:

• Investigate the rheology and processability of granular materials, including yield stress, plastic viscosity,thixotropy, water content, ageing and particle interactions.

• Study microbial activity and biologically driven mineral precipitation, and determine how evolving mineralphases affect mechanical hardening and material performance.

• Characterize the coupling between biogeochemical reactions, rheological properties and mechanicalbehaviour over space and time.

• Connect experimental findings to extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying in collaboration with thedigital fabrication team at ETH Zurich.

Profile

• An MSc degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering or aclosely related discipline.

• A background in mechanics and the strength of solid materials, or materials science applied to the builtenvironment, is particularly welcome.

• Experience in rheology, granular or cementitious materials, experimental mechanics, materialcharacterization, geomechanics, mineralogy, or organic and inorganic chemistry is an advantage.Expertise across all these fields is neither expected nor required.

• Interest in experimental and interdisciplinary research, and in translating fundamental physical andchemical understanding into new construction technologies.

• Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team across disciplines and institutions.

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eagerness to learn, good organizational skills and rigor in experimentalwork.

• A high level of motivation for academic research.

• Fluency in English is essential.

Sie arbeiten im Rahmen des vom Schweizerischen Nationalfonds (SNF) geförderten Projekts „DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems, das in Zusammenarbeit zwischen Dr. Dimitrios Terzis, Senior Scientist in der LalouiGroup der EPFL, und Co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger vom Lehrstuhl für Digitale Gebäudetechnik an der ETHZurich. Das Projekt untersucht, wie biologisch bedingte Mineralisierung Abbruch- und Aushubmaterialien in Materialien verwandeln kann, die für die digitale Herstellung unter Umgebungsbedingungen geeignet sind.

Digitale Fertigungsmethoden, einschließlich Extrusions-3D-Druck und Roboterspritzen, bieten Möglichkeiten zur Steuerung der Materialplatzierung und -härtung, zur Schaffung komplexer Geometrien und zur Reduzierung des Materialverbrauchs. Die Integration der Biomineralisierung in pumpfähige, extrudierbare und versprühbare Granulate bleibt weitgehend unerforscht. Dieses PhD wird die gekoppelten biogeochemischen, rheologischen und mechanischen Mechanismen untersuchen, die die Partikelabscheidung, Mineralfällung und -härtung steuern.

Mission

Nous vous proposons un poste de doctorant à temps plein (100 %) au sein du groupe Laloui de l'EPFL à Lausanne. Le groupe apporte son expertise en géomatériaux et leur comportement mécanique à la recherche à l'interface des applications en sciences des matériaux et en génie.

Vous travaillerez sur le projet financé par la Fondation nationale suisse de la science (SNSF) «DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems» mené en collaboration avec le Dr Dimitrios Terzis, scientifique senior du Groupe Laloui à l'EPFL, et le co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger de la chaire des technologies de construction numérique à ETHZurich. Le projet étudie comment la minéralisation biologique peut transformer les matériaux de démolition et d'excavation en matériaux adaptés à la fabrication numérique dans des conditions ambiantes.

Les méthodes de fabrication numériques, y compris l'impression 3D d'extrusion et la pulvérisation robotisée, offrent la possibilité de contrôler le placement et le durcissement des matériaux, de créer des géométries complexes et de réduire la consommation de matériaux. L'intégration de la biominéralisation dans des matériaux granulaires pulvérulents, extrudables et pulvérulents reste largement inexplorée. CePhD étudiera les mécanismes biogéochimiques, rhéologiques et mécaniques associés qui régissent ladeposition des particules, les précipitations minérales et le durcissement.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

En tant que doctorant, vous devrez :

• Prenez l'entière responsabilité de votre thèse et de l'avancement de vos recherches.

• Mener des recherches en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires du projet à l'EPFL et à l'ETH Zurich et, le cas échéant, avec les partenaires industriels.

• Concevoir et exécuter des expériences, et analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux.

• Écrire des articles scientifiques pour publication dans des revues évaluées par des pairs et présenter vos conclusions lors de conférences internationales.

• Participer à l'enseignement et superviser les projets étudiants.

Plus précisément, dans le cadre de ce projet, vous pourrez :

• Étudier la rhéologie et la processabilité des matériaux granulaires, y compris la contrainte de rendement, la viscosité plastique, la thixotropie, la teneur en eau, le vieillissement et les interactions des particules.

• Étudier l'activité microbienne et les précipitations minérales d'origine biologique, et déterminer comment l'évolution des phases minérales affecte le durcissement mécanique et la performance des matériaux.

• Caractériser le couplage entre les réactions biogéochimiques, les propriétés rhéologiques et le comportement mécanique dans l'espace et le temps.

• Connectez les résultats expérimentaux à l'impression 3D d'extrusion et à la pulvérisation robotique en collaboration avec l'équipe de fabrication numérique de l'ETH Zurich.

Profil

• Maîtrise en génie civil, sciences des matériaux et génie, génie chimique ou discipline étroitement liée.

• Une formation en mécanique et la force des matériaux solides, ou la science des matériaux appliquée à l'environnement bâti, sont particulièrement bienvenues.

• L'expérience en rhéologie, en matériaux granulaires ou cimentaires, en mécanique expérimentale, en caractérisation des matériaux, en géomécanique, en minéralogie ou en chimie organique et inorganique est un avantage. L'expertise dans tous ces domaines n'est ni attendue ni requise.

• Intérêt pour la recherche expérimentale et interdisciplinaire, et pour la traduction de la compréhension physique et chimique fondamentale en nouvelles technologies de construction.

• Bonnes compétences en communication et volonté de travailler dans le cadre d'une équipe de disciplines et d'institutions.

• Enthousiasme, curiosité scientifique, empressement à apprendre, bonnes aptitudes organisationnelles et rigueur dans le travail expérimental.

jobs.description:
Mission

The Laboratory of Biomedical Microfluidics (LBMM; www.epfl.ch/labs/lbmm ) at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL), is looking for postdocs with a primary training in cell biology and next generation sequencing. Experience in droplet-microfluidics, including use of commercial devices such as the 10X Genomics platform is beneficial, but not absolutely crucial.

For two decades, LBMM has developed powerful technology platforms in the field of biomedicine and genomics, also resulting in the establishment of two startup companies ( www.veraxa.de and www.thera-me.ch ) and a NASDAQ IPO. Having a comprehensive microﬂuidic toolbox at hand (and expanding it continuously), we are now inviting applications for highly multiplexed RNAseq-based screening for optimal T-cell expansion protocols. In close collaboration with the lab of George Coukos ( https://agora-cancer.ch/laboratory/coukos-lab/ ), we will derive protocols enabling rapid expansion of cancer-specific, autologous TILs for clinical application. The project will be based on repurposing existing microfluidic platforms (e.g. Mathur et al., Nature Communications, Utharala et al., Nature Protocols).

The LBMM has a very translational focus, running a tech development lab on the EPFL campus and a translational lab in the AGORA cancer research center (with direct access to patient material). Furthermore, a strong network of clinical partners in Europe and the US has been established.

The successful candidate will closely interact with experts in microfluidics and bioinformatics, while spearheading the above project.

Main duties and responsibilities include

• Optimization of microfluidic and biochemical workflows

• Development of miniaturized T-cell expansion assays, including feeder cells

• Preparation of NGS libraries

• Data analysis with help from a bioinformatics facility

Your profile

• Hands-on experience in cell biology and NGS

• Good knowledge in T-cell expansion and therapy

• Motivated in driving tech development

• Prior experience in microfluidics is advantageous but not absolutely required

• Good communication skills

We offer

• A multidisciplinary environment

• Exposure to the latest cutting-edge experimental procedures (e.g. custom microfluidic platforms and sequencing approaches)

• Preparation for a future career in academia, industry or startup companies

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

• A CV with a publication list.

• A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).

• Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: Prof. Christoph Merten, christoph.merten@epfl.ch

Having a comprehensive microﬂuidic toolbox at hand (and expanding it continuously), we are now inviting applications for highly multiplexed RNAseq-based screening for optimal T-cell expansion protocols. In close collaboration with the lab of George Coukos ( https://agora-cancer.ch/laboratory/coukos-lab/ ), we will derive protocols enabling rapid expansion of cancer-specific, autologous TILs for clinical application. The project will be based on repurposing existing microfluidic platforms (e.g. Mathur et al., Nature Communications, Utharala et al., Nature Protocols).

The LBMM has a very translational focus, running a tech development lab on the EPFL campus and a translational lab in the AGORA cancer research center (with direct access to patient material). Furthermore, a strong network of clinical partners in Europe and the US has been established.

The successful candidate will closely interact with experts in microfluidics and bioinformatics, while spearheading the above project.

Main duties and responsibilities include

• Optimization of microfluidic and biochemical workflows

• Development of miniaturized T-cell expansion assays, including feeder cells

• Preparation of NGS libraries

• Data analysis with help from a bioinformatics facility

Your profile

• Hands-on experience in cell biology and NGS

• Good knowledge in T-cell expansion and therapy

• Motivated in driving tech development

• Prior experience in microfluidics is advantageous but not absolutely required

• Good communication skills

We offer

• A multidisciplinary environment

• Exposure to the latest cutting-edge experimental procedures (e.g. custom microfluidic platforms and sequencing approaches)

• Preparation for a future career in academia, industry or startup companies

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

• A CV with a publication list.

• A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).

• Contact details for 3 referees.

jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL AI Center focuses on advancing research, education and innovation in AI at EPFL and beyond. It is at the core of a vibrant EPFL community and dynamic external ecosystem that includes a large number of partners and stakeholders in AI, including academia, industry, government, and international organisations. In this dynamic and exciting ecosystem, the EPFL AI Center strives to promote a responsible and inclusive vision for AI.

Main duties and responsibilities

Do you want to drive positive impact in our society through AI? Are you motivated to help EPFL unleash its potential in AI and position the institution at the forefront of AI in Switzerland and worldwide?

Apply Now!

We are looking for a dynamic Communications Officer to help us amplify our important messages to the AI Center stakeholders and the society, increase visibility and impact, nurture our community and tell compelling stories from the world of AI and contribute to developing the communication strategy. You’ll work closely with the Head of AI Communication, the EPFL AI Center team, the Vice-Presidency for Support to Strategic Initiatives and EPFL’s communications unit Mediacom and the communications office of EPFL Schools. You will also develop close interactions with your peers at the ETHZ AI Center through the Swiss National AI Institute.

Your main responsibilities:

• Content creation: Creating and editing content for various formats (articles, interviews, announcements, press releases, web pages)

• Visual storytelling: Developing visuals and communication materials (presentations, posters, brochures, signage, social media assets)

• Website and social media : contribute to web content and social media presence

• Media relations: With the support of Mediacom, coordinate coverage and interviews with keynote speakers and guests

• Supporting community engagement and internal communication across EPFL, including initiatives to encourage responsible AI adoption and related events

Profile

• At least 5 years of professional experience in communication, ideally in science, technology, or academic environments

• University-level education (Bachelor or Master’s) in communication, marketing, media studies, journalism, or a related field

• Enthusiastic, resourceful, curious—and excited to work at the intersection of science and society

• Ability to integrate in highly dynamic environments, capabilities for managing several projects at once and meeting deadlines

• French and English at conversational level, German is a plus

• Visual communication skills: manage visuals and produce content yourself, including shooting and editing both photo and video content

• Strong branding and storytelling skills

• Familiarity with AI tools and technology

• Familiarity with EPFL, Swiss academia, or AI-related topics is a plus

• Experience with event management is a plus

We offer

• A dynamic role at the heart of EPFL’s growing AI ecosystem

• Flexible work hours and a stimulating, intellectually rich environment

• Exposure to cutting-edge science, top researchers, highly dynamic ecosystem and global conversations around AI

At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation.

We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference.

Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.

Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits

Missione

L'EPFL AI Center si concentra sull'avanzamento della ricerca, dell'istruzione e dell'innovazione in AI all'EPFL e oltre. È al centro di una vivace comunità EPFL e di un ecosistema esterno dinamico che comprende un gran numero di partner e stakeholder in AI, tra cui accademia, industria, governo e organizzazioni internazionali. In questo ecosistema dinamico ed emozionante, l'EPFL AI Center si sforza di promuovere una visione responsabile e inclusiva per l'AI.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Vuoi guidare un impatto positivo nella nostra società attraverso l'IA? Sei motivato ad aiutare EPFL a liberare il suo potenziale in AI e a posizionare l'istituzione all'avanguardia dell'IA in Svizzera e in tutto il mondo?

Applica ora!

Stiamo cercando un responsabile delle comunicazioni dinamico per aiutarci ad amplificare i nostri messaggi importanti agli stakeholder del Centro AI e alla società, aumentare la visibilità e l'impatto, nutrire la nostra comunità e raccontare storie convincenti dal mondo dell'AI e contribuire a sviluppare la strategia di comunicazione. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il responsabile della comunicazione AI, il team di EPFL AI Center, la vicepresidenza per il supporto alle iniziative strategiche e l'unità di comunicazione di EPFL Mediacom e l'ufficio di comunicazione delle scuole EPFL. Potrai anche sviluppare interazioni strette con i tuoi coetanei presso il Centro AI ETHZ attraverso l'Istituto Nazionale di AI svizzero.

Le vostre principali responsabilità:

• Creazione di contenuti: Creazione e modifica di contenuti per vari formati (articoli, interviste, annunci, comunicati stampa, pagine web)

• Storie visive: Sviluppo di materiali visivi e di comunicazione (presentazioni, manifesti, brochure, segnaletica, beni di social media)

• Sito web e social media: contribuire al contenuto web e alla presenza dei social media

• Media Relations: Con il supporto di Mediacom, coordinate di copertura e interviste con relatori e ospiti keynote

• Sostenere l'impegno della comunità e la comunicazione interna attraverso EPFL, comprese le iniziative per incoraggiare l'adozione responsabile dell'AI e gli eventi correlati

Profilo

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella comunicazione, idealmente in scienza, tecnologia o ambienti accademici

• Istruzione universitaria (Bachelor o Master) in comunicazione, marketing, studi di media, giornalismo, o un campo correlato

• Enthusiastic, intraprendente, curioso e entusiasta di lavorare all'incrocio tra scienza e società

• Capacità di integrare in ambienti altamente dinamici, capacità di gestione di diversi progetti in una sola volta e tempi di incontro

• Francese e inglese a livello di conversazione, il tedesco è un plus

• Capacità di comunicazione visiva: gestire la visualizzazione e produrre contenuti da soli, tra cui riprese e editing sia di contenuti fotografici che video

• Forte capacità di branding e storytelling

• Familiarità con gli strumenti e la tecnologia AI

• La familiarità con EPFL, l'accademia svizzera o gli argomenti relativi all'intelligenza artificiale è un plus

• Esperienza con gestione degli eventi è un plus

Offriamo

• Un ruolo dinamico nel cuore del crescente ecosistema AI di EPFL

• Ore lavorative flessibili e un ambiente stimolante e intellettuale

• Esposizione a scienza all'avanguardia, ricercatori di alto livello, ecosistema altamente dinamico e conversazioni globali intorno AI

In EPFL, crediamo che le persone ottengono grandi risultati quando si sentono sostenuti, rispettati e abilitati per avere successo. Unendo la nostra comunità, contribuirete a plasmare il futuro della società attraverso l'istruzione, la ricerca e l'innovazione.

Offriamo un ambiente stimolante, internazionale e collaborativo in cui il vostro lavoro ha un impatto reale e le vostre idee sono valutate. In combinazione con modi flessibili di lavoro e condizioni di lavoro interessanti, ci proponiamo di creare un ambiente in cui tutti possono contribuire, crescere e fare la differenza.

Oltre al lavoro, i nostri campus ospitano una vivace comunità e un ambiente unico, arricchiti da iniziative che promuovono l'uguaglianza, l'inclusione, la diversità, il benessere e la sostenibilità, nonché un coinvolgente programma di attività culturali, sportive e comunitarie durante tutto l'anno.

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Création de contenu: Création et édition de contenu pour différents formats (articles, interviews, annonces, communiqués de presse, pages web)

• Scénario visuel: développement de matériel visuel et de communication (présentations, affiches, brochures, affiches, supports de médias sociaux)

• Site web et médias sociaux : contribuer au contenu web et à la présence des médias sociaux

• Relations avec les médias : Avec le soutien de Mediacom, coordonner la couverture et les entretiens avec les conférenciers et les invités

• Soutenir l'engagement communautaire et la communication interne à l'EPFL, y compris les initiatives visant à encourager l'adoption responsable de l'IA et les événements connexes

Profil

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en communication, idéalement dans les milieux scientifiques, technologiques ou universitaires

• Enseignement universitaire (Bachelor ou Master) en communication, marketing, études médiatiques, journalisme ou domaine connexe

• Enthousiaste, débrouillard, curieux – et excité de travailler au carrefour de la science et de la société

• Capacité à s'intégrer dans des environnements très dynamiques, capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en même temps et respect des délais

• Français et anglais au niveau conversationnel, l'allemand est un plus

• Compétences en communication visuelle : gérer les visuels et produire du contenu vous-même, y compris la prise de vue et l'édition du contenu photo et vidéo

• Fortes compétences de marque et de narration

• Connaissance des outils et de la technologie de l'IA

• Familiarité avec l'EPFL, l'université suisse, ou les sujets liés à l'IA est un plus

• L'expérience de la gestion des événements est un plus

Nous offrons

• Un rôle dynamique au cœur de l'écosystème d'IA en pleine croissance de l'EPFL

• Des heures de travail flexibles et un environnement stimulant, riche intellectuellement

• Exposition à la science de pointe, aux meilleurs chercheurs, aux écosystèmes très dynamiques et aux conversations mondiales autour de l'IA

À l'EPFL, nous croyons que les gens obtiennent de grands résultats lorsqu'ils se sentent soutenus, respectés et capables de réussir. En vous joignant à notre communauté, vous aiderez à façonner l'avenir de la société par l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation.

Nous offrons un environnement inspirant, international et collaboratif où votre travail a un impact réel et vos idées sont valorisées. Combinés à des modes de travail flexibles et à des conditions d'emploi attrayantes, nous voulons créer un environnement où chacun peut contribuer, grandir et faire la différence.

Au-delà du travail, nos campus accueillent une communauté dynamique et un environnement unique, enrichi par des initiatives favorisant l'égalité, l'inclusion, la diversité, le bien-être et la durabilité, ainsi qu'un programme mobilisant d'activités culturelles, sportives et communautaires tout au long de l'année.

Découvrez nos conditions d'emploi et nos avantages sociaux

jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL Al Center focuses on advancing research, education and innovation in Al at EPFL and beyond. It is at the core of a vibrant EPFL community and dynamic external ecosystem that includes a large number of partners and stakeholders in Al, including academia, industry, government, and international organisations.

Location: EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland (this position requires being physically on campus)

Are you passionate about driving positive impact in our society through AI? Are you motivated to help EPFL unleash its enormous potential in AI and position the institution at the forefront of AI in Switzerland and worldwide? Do you have experience in establishing and managing excellent collaborations between researchers and industry partners?

The EPFL AI Center focuses on advancing research, education and innovation in AI at EPFL and beyond. It is at the core of a vibrant EPFL community and dynamic external ecosystem that includes a large number of partners and stakeholders in AI, including academia, industry, government, and international organisations. To supplement our team, we seek a dynamic Partnership and Business Developer with a can-do mindset. The Partnership and Business Developer builds, supports and nurtures a trustful relationship between industrial partners and the research, education and innovation ecosystem of the EPFL AI Center and the Swiss National AI Institute. You will be able to identify needs and requirements to develop industry-academia collaboration. You will be a privileged point of contact for multiple collaboration models in the various EPFL AI Center initiatives.

Main duties and responsibilities

Your mission will be to develop and execute strategic industry partnership programs in the EPFL AI Center and the Swiss National AI Institute, as well as support and manage the whole lifecycle of different partnership programs.

In the course of this, you will interact with a large number of stakeholders in- and outside EPFL, and collaborate tightly with ETHZ AI Center. You will also work closely with the EPFL Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI), developing a solid knowledge of the EPFL Innovation ecosystem, including research laboratories, students and startups, to become a privileged point of contact for a portfolio of companies in the AI industry and a trusted point of contact for researchers in the EPFL AI Center.

• Build relationships with new industry partners, identify new potential industry partners in AI (prospecting, networking, market research,…)

• Be proactive in proposing new potential collaboration opportunities by following EPFL research activities

• Resolve any issues and problems the partner faces and deal with complaints to maintain trust and enrich existing collaboration

• Serve as the communication link between companies, researchers, EPFL AI Center, Swiss National AI Institute, as well as EPFL & VPI teams and services, for industry partnerships in AI

• Represent the EPFL AI Center and the Swiss National AI Institute, and organize industrial visits and meetings.

• Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts using key account metrics.

• Acquire a thorough understanding of companies and professors' needs and ensure appropriate collaboration models and services are developed and delivered. Link to other EPFL entities depending on the needs.

• Acquire a strong knowledge and understanding of the EPFL AI ecosystem for helping companies to identify the right partners for their innovation projects

Profile

• Degree in science or engineering (Master or Doctorate), demonstrating in-depth understanding of entrepreneurial or project management processes and solid scientific expertise, ideally in AI;

• At least 3 years of of relevant experience, ideally in a dynamic environment;

• Former experience in product development and/or innovation management in a technology company, or consulting. Experience in providing solutions based on customer needs.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities;

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with aptitude in building relationships with professionals of all organization levels and different cultures.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability in problem-solving and negotiation.

• Desire to create a wider impact through your work. Passion for the field of AI.

• Team player, autonomous, curious with a strong commitment to results.

• Familiarity with research and education sectors;

• Proficiency in English and French.

We offer

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Access to a diverse and dynamic community of researchers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.

• A stimulating and friendly work atmosphere with excellent working conditions.

• An inclusive workspace and equal opportunities for all.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

L'EPFL Al Center si concentra sull'avanzamento della ricerca, dell'istruzione e dell'innovazione in Al a EPFL e oltre. È al centro di una vivace comunità EPFL e di un ecosistema esterno dinamico che comprende un gran numero di partner e stakeholders in Al, tra cui accademia, industria, governo e organizzazioni internazionali.

Posizione: EPFL, Losanna, Svizzera (questa posizione richiede di essere fisicamente nel campus)

Sei appassionato di guidare l'impatto positivo nella nostra società attraverso l'IA? Sei motivato ad aiutare EPFL a liberare il suo enorme potenziale in AI e a posizionare l'istituzione in prima linea dell'IA in Svizzera e in tutto il mondo? Hai esperienza nella creazione e nella gestione di eccellenti collaborazioni tra ricercatori e partner del settore?

L'EPFL AI Center si concentra sull'avanzamento della ricerca, dell'istruzione e dell'innovazione in AI all'EPFL e oltre. È al centro di una vivace comunità EPFL e di un ecosistema esterno dinamico che comprende un gran numero di partner e stakeholder in AI, tra cui accademia, industria, governo e organizzazioni internazionali. Per integrare il nostro team, cerchiamo un partenariato dinamico e uno sviluppatore aziendale con una mentalità in grado di fare. Il Partnership and Business Developer costruisce, sostiene e alimenta un rapporto di fiducia tra partner industriali e ecosistema di ricerca, istruzione e innovazione dell'EPFL AI Center e dell'Istituto Nazionale dell'AI. Sarete in grado di identificare le esigenze e i requisiti per sviluppare la collaborazione industria-accademia. Sarete un punto di contatto privilegiato per molteplici modelli di collaborazione nelle varie iniziative dell'EPFL AI Center.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

La vostra missione sarà quella di sviluppare ed eseguire programmi di partnership strategici del settore nel Centro AI EPFL e nell'Istituto Nazionale di AI, oltre a sostenere e gestire l'intero ciclo di vita di diversi programmi di partnership.

Nel corso di questo, si interagirà con un gran numero di stakeholder in- e fuori EPFL, e collaborare strettamente con ETHZ AI Center. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con l'EPFL Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI), sviluppando una solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema EPFL Innovation, tra cui laboratori di ricerca, studenti e startup, per diventare un punto di contatto privilegiato per un portafoglio di aziende nel settore AI e un punto di contatto affidabile per i ricercatori dell'EPFL AI Center.

• Costruire relazioni con nuovi partner del settore, identificare nuovi potenziali partner del settore in AI (prospettive, networking, ricerca di mercato,...)

• Siate proattivi nel proporre nuove potenziali opportunità di collaborazione seguendo le attività di ricerca EPFL

• Risolvere eventuali problemi e problemi che il partner affronta e affrontare reclami per mantenere la fiducia e arricchire la collaborazione esistente

• Serve come collegamento di comunicazione tra aziende, ricercatori, EPFL AI Center, Swiss National AI Institute, nonché team e servizi EPFL & VPI, per partnership industriali in AI

• Rappresentare l'EPFL AI Center e l'Istituto Nazionale dell'AI e organizzare visite e incontri industriali.

• Preparare rapporti regolari di progresso e previsioni utilizzando metriche chiave del conto.

• Acquisire una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze delle aziende e dei professori e garantire modelli e servizi di collaborazione adeguati sono sviluppati e consegnati. Collegamento ad altre entità EPFL a seconda delle esigenze.

• Acquisire una forte conoscenza e comprensione dell'ecosistema EPFL AI per aiutare le aziende a identificare i partner giusti per i loro progetti di innovazione

Profilo

• Laurea in scienze o ingegneria (Master o Dottorato), dimostrando una comprensione approfondita dei processi di gestione imprenditoriale o di progetto e solida competenza scientifica, idealmente in AI;

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza rilevante, idealmente in un ambiente dinamico;

• Ex esperienza nello sviluppo del prodotto e/o nella gestione dell'innovazione in un'azienda tecnologica o nella consulenza. Esperienza nella fornitura di soluzioni basate sulle esigenze del cliente.

• Capacità di gestire più compiti e progetti contemporaneamente, e prosperare in un ambiente veloce con più priorità;

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali con aptitude nella costruzione di relazioni con i professionisti di tutti i livelli di organizzazione e culture diverse.

• Eccellente capacità organizzativa e capacità di problem solving e negoziazione.

• Desideri creare un impatto più ampio attraverso il tuo lavoro. Passione per il campo dell'AI.

• Giocatore di squadra, autonomo, curioso con un forte impegno per i risultati.

• Familiarità con i settori della ricerca e dell'istruzione;

• Competenza in inglese e francese.

Offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e innovativo.

• Accesso a una comunità diversificata e dinamica di ricercatori, imprenditori ed esperti del settore.

• Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e amichevole con eccellenti condizioni di lavoro.

• Uno spazio di lavoro inclusivo e pari opportunità per tutti.

Leggi le nostre condizioni di lavoro e le prestazioni dei dipendenti

Informazioni

Tasso di attività Min: 80.00

Tasso di attività Max: 100.00

Tipo di contratto: CDD

Durata: 1 anno, eventualmente rinnovabile

Riferimento: 2586

Si prega di notare che solo le domande che soddisfano i criteri dell'annuncio saranno considerate.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Das EPFL Al Center konzentriert sich auf die Förderung von Forschung, Bildung und Innovation in Al an der EPFL und darüber hinaus. Es ist das Herzstück einer lebendigen EPFL-Gemeinschaft und eines dynamischen externen Ökosystems, das eine große Anzahl von Partnern und Stakeholdern in Al umfasst, darunter Wissenschaft, Industrie, Regierung und internationale Organisationen.

Standort: EPFL, Lausanne, Schweiz (diese Position erfordert, physisch auf dem Campus zu sein)

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, durch KI positive Auswirkungen in unserer Gesellschaft zu erzielen? Sind Sie motiviert, die EPFL dabei zu unterstützen, ihr enormes Potenzial in der KI zu entfalten und die Institution an der Spitze der KI in der Schweiz und weltweit zu positionieren? Haben Sie Erfahrung im Aufbau und Management exzellenter Kooperationen zwischen Forschern und Industriepartnern?

Das EPFL AI Center konzentriert sich auf die Förderung von Forschung, Bildung und Innovation in der KI an der EPFL und darüber hinaus. Es ist das Herzstück einer lebendigen EPFL-Gemeinschaft und eines dynamischen externen Ökosystems, das eine große Anzahl von Partnern und Stakeholdern in der KI umfasst, darunter Wissenschaft, Industrie, Regierung und internationale Organisationen. Um unser Team zu ergänzen, suchen wir einen dynamischen Partnerschafts- und Geschäftsentwickler mit einer Can-Do-Mentalität. Der Partnership and Business Developer baut, unterstützt und pflegt eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung zwischen Industriepartnern und dem Forschungs-, Bildungs- und Innovations-Ökosystem des EPFL AI Center und des Swiss National AI Institute. Sie werden in der Lage sein, Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen zu identifizieren, um die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Industrie und Hochschulen zu entwickeln. Sie werden ein privilegierter Ansprechpartner für mehrere Kollaborationsmodelle in den verschiedenen EPFL AI Center-Initiativen sein.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Ihre Mission ist die Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Industriepartnerschaftsprogramme im EPFL AI Center und im Swiss National AI Institute sowie die Unterstützung und Verwaltung des gesamten Lebenszyklus verschiedener Partnerschaftsprogramme.

Sie werden dabei mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern innerhalb und außerhalb der EPFL interagieren und eng mit dem ETHZ AI Center zusammenarbeiten. Sie arbeiten auch eng mit der EPFL Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI) zusammen und entwickeln ein solides Wissen über das EPFL Innovation-Ökosystem, einschließlich Forschungslabors, Studenten und Start-ups, um ein privilegierter Ansprechpartner für ein Portfolio von Unternehmen der KI-Branche und ein vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Forscher im EPFL AI Center zu werden.

• Aufbau von Beziehungen zu neuen Industriepartnern, Identifizierung neuer potenzieller Industriepartner in der KI (Prospektion, Vernetzung, Marktforschung, ...)

• Seien Sie proaktiv, indem Sie neue potenzielle Kooperationsmöglichkeiten vorschlagen, indem Sie die EPFL-Forschungsaktivitäten verfolgen

• Lösen Sie alle Probleme und Probleme, mit denen der Partner konfrontiert ist, und behandeln Sie Beschwerden, um das Vertrauen zu wahren und die bestehende Zusammenarbeit zu bereichern

• Dienen Sie als Kommunikationsverbindung zwischen Unternehmen, Forschern, EPFL AI Center, Swiss National AI Institute sowie EPFL & VPI-Teams und -Services für Branchenpartnerschaften in der KI

• Repräsentieren Sie das EPFL AI Center und das Swiss National AI Institute und organisieren Sie Industriebesuche und Meetings.

• Erstellen Sie regelmäßige Berichte über Fortschritte und Prognosen mit Key-Account-Metriken.

• Erwerben Sie ein gründliches Verständnis der Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und Professoren und stellen Sie sicher, dass geeignete Kooperationsmodelle und -dienste entwickelt und bereitgestellt werden. Verbindung zu anderen EPFL-Stellen je nach Bedarf.

• Erwerben Sie ein fundiertes Wissen und Verständnis des EPFL AI-Ökosystems, um Unternehmen dabei zu helfen, die richtigen Partner für ihre Innovationsprojekte zu finden

Profil

• Abschluss in Naturwissenschaften oder Ingenieurwissenschaften (Master oder Doktorat), die ein tiefes Verständnis von unternehmerischen oder Projektmanagementprozessen und solide wissenschaftliche Expertise, idealerweise in KI, demonstrieren;

• Mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld;

• Frühere Erfahrung in der Produktentwicklung und / oder Innovationsmanagement in einem Technologieunternehmen oder Beratung. Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von Lösungen basierend auf Kundenbedürfnissen.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten und in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung mit mehreren Prioritäten zu gedeihen;

• Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit Eignung beim Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Fachleuten aller Organisationsebenen und verschiedener Kulturen.

• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten in Problemlösung und Verhandlung.

• Möchten Sie durch Ihre Arbeit eine breitere Wirkung erzielen. Leidenschaft für den Bereich AI.

• Teamplayer, autonom, neugierig mit einem starken Engagement für Ergebnisse.

• Vertrautheit mit den Bereichen Forschung und Bildung;

• Kenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch.

Wir bieten

• Kollaboratives und innovatives Arbeitsumfeld.

• Zugang zu einer vielfältigen und dynamischen Gemeinschaft von Forschern, Unternehmern und Branchenexperten.

• Eine anregende und freundliche Arbeitsatmosphäre mit hervorragenden Arbeitsbedingungen.

• Ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz und Chancengleichheit für alle.
