Le Centre Al de l'EPFL met l'accent sur la recherche, l'éducation et l'innovation à l'EPFL et au-delà. Elle est au cœur d'une communauté EPFL dynamique et d'un écosystème extérieur dynamique qui regroupe un grand nombre de partenaires et d'acteurs d'Al, y compris des milieux universitaires, industriels, gouvernementaux et des organisations internationales.

Lieu: EPFL, Lausanne, Suisse (ce poste nécessite d'être physiquement sur le campus)

Êtes-vous passionné par l'impact positif de l'IA dans notre société? Êtes-vous motivé à aider l'EPFL à libérer son énorme potentiel en AI et à positionner l'institution à la pointe de l'IA en Suisse et dans le monde ? Avez-vous de l'expérience dans l'établissement et la gestion d'excellentes collaborations entre chercheurs et partenaires industriels?

Le Centre AI de l'EPFL met l'accent sur la recherche, l'éducation et l'innovation en AI à l'EPFL et au-delà. Elle est au cœur d'une communauté dynamique et d'un écosystème extérieur dynamique qui regroupe un grand nombre de partenaires et d'acteurs de l'IA, y compris les milieux universitaires, l'industrie, le gouvernement et les organisations internationales. Pour compléter notre équipe, nous recherchons un partenariat dynamique et un développeur d'affaires avec un état d'esprit candide. Le Partenariat et Business Developer construit, soutient et entretient une relation de confiance entre les partenaires industriels et l'écosystème de recherche, d'éducation et d'innovation du Centre AI de l'EPFL et de l'Institut national suisse de l'IA. Vous serez en mesure de déterminer les besoins et les exigences pour développer la collaboration industrie-université. Vous serez un point de contact privilégié pour plusieurs modèles de collaboration dans les différentes initiatives du Centre AI de l'EPFL.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

Votre mission sera de développer et d'exécuter des programmes stratégiques de partenariat industriel au sein du Centre AI de l'EPFL et de l'Institut national suisse de l'IA, ainsi que de soutenir et de gérer tout le cycle de vie de différents programmes de partenariat.

Dans ce cadre, vous interagirez avec un grand nombre de parties prenantes à l'EPFL et à l'extérieur, et collaborerez étroitement avec ETHZ AI Center. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la vice-présidence de l'EPFL pour l'innovation et l'impact (VPI), développant une solide connaissance de l'écosystème de l'innovation de l'EPFL, y compris les laboratoires de recherche, les étudiants et les startups, pour devenir un point de contact privilégié pour un portefeuille d'entreprises de l'industrie de l'IA et un point de contact de confiance pour les chercheurs du Centre de l'IA de l'EPFL.

• Établir des relations avec de nouveaux partenaires de l'industrie, identifier de nouveaux partenaires potentiels de l'industrie de l'IA (prospection, réseautage, études de marché,...)

• Soyez proactif en proposant de nouvelles possibilités de collaboration en suivant les activités de recherche de l'EPFL

• Résoudre les problèmes auxquels le partenaire est confronté et traiter les plaintes afin de maintenir la confiance et d'enrichir la collaboration existante

• Servir de lien de communication entre les entreprises, les chercheurs, le Centre AI de l'EPFL, l'Institut national suisse de l'IA, ainsi que les équipes et services EPFL & VPI, pour les partenariats industriels en AI

• Représenter le Centre AI de l'EPFL et l'Institut national suisse de l'IA, et organiser des visites industrielles et des réunions.

jobs.description:
Mission

Your mission is to perform research within the theory of computation group at EPFL. Specific areas of research include probabilistic proofs, succinct arguments, combinatorial optimization, approximation algorithms, online algorithms, sublinear algorithms, (quantum) computational complexity (proof complexity, communication complexity, etc.), quantum cryptography, algorithms and quantum learning theory.

Main duties and responsibilities

You will carry out independent research within the theory group. You will have large latitude to select the topics that best fit your profile and interest, within the scope of the theory group. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with PhD and Masters students. You are also encouraged to collaborate with other research groups at EPFL, whenever relevant.

Postdocs may contribute to teaching. This is generally not required but should be discussed with the hosting professor as department requirements vary.

Profile

• Recent Ph.D. graduate or postdoc

• Proven scientific excellence in theoretical computer science

• Strong publication record

• Evidence of independence in research

• Leadership skills and good integration in a research group

We offer

EPFL is located in Lausanne (Switzerland) and ranks among the world’s top scientific universities. In French-speaking Lausanne, English is generally well spoken and is the main language at EPFL. Postdoctoral positions come with a competitive salary based on the EPFL salary scales for postdocs , renewable up to a maximum of 4 years. Postdoctoral scholars will work in a collaborative environment where they can further develop their research skills and expand their professional network, as well as:

• Excellent working conditions;

• Opportunity to contribute to the development of higher education;

• Very stimulating multicultural working environment;

• An excellent teamwork atmosphere

Informations

Faculty may reach out to applicants on a rolling basis, though we encourage inquiries to be made as soon as possible.

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• Cover letter

(identify one or more faculty of interest and provide availability)

• CV
(including a ranked list of at least three writers for letters of reference)

• Research statement (covering research interests, past research focus, and future research directions)

Additional information may be obtained by e-mail to theory-postdoc@epfl.ch

(no applications sent to this address shall be considered)

· Contract Start Date : September 1st, 2027.

· Submissions will be considered until February 28, 2027

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

La vostra missione è di eseguire ricerche all'interno della teoria del gruppo di calcolo a EPFL. Le aree specifiche di ricerca includono prove probabilistiche, argomenti succinti, ottimizzazione combinatoria, algoritmi di approssimazione, algoritmi online, algoritmi sublineari, (quantum) complessità computazionale (complessità a prova, complessità della comunicazione, ecc.), crittografia quantistica, algoritmi e teoria dell'apprendimento quantistico.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Si effettuerà una ricerca indipendente all'interno del gruppo di teoria. Avrai grande latitudine per selezionare gli argomenti che meglio si adattano al tuo profilo e interesse, nell'ambito del gruppo di teoria. Avrete l'opportunità di collaborare con studenti di dottorato e Master. Sei anche incoraggiato a collaborare con altri gruppi di ricerca all'EPFL, quando necessario.

I postdoc possono contribuire all'insegnamento. Questo non è generalmente richiesto, ma dovrebbe essere discusso con il professore di hosting come requisiti di reparto variano.

Profilo

• Recenti Ph.D. laureati o postdoc

• Eccellenza scientifica provata nella scienza informatica teorica

• Forte record di pubblicazione

• Prove di indipendenza nella ricerca

• Competenze di leadership e buona integrazione in un gruppo di ricerca

Offriamo

EPFL si trova a Losanna (Svizzera) e si trova tra le migliori università scientifiche del mondo. In lingua francese Lausanne, l'inglese è generalmente ben parlato ed è la lingua principale in EPFL. Le posizioni postdoctoral sono dotate di uno stipendio competitivo basato sulle scale salariali EPFL per postdocs, rinnovabile fino ad un massimo di 4 anni. Gli studiosi post-dottorali lavoreranno in un ambiente collaborativo dove potranno sviluppare ulteriormente le loro capacità di ricerca e ampliare la loro rete professionale, così come:

• Condizioni di lavoro eccellenti;

• Opportunità di contribuire allo sviluppo dell'istruzione superiore;

• Ambiente di lavoro multiculturale molto stimolante;

• Un'ottima atmosfera di lavoro di squadra

Informazioni

La facoltà può raggiungere i candidati su base regolare, anche se incoraggiamo le indagini da effettuare il più presto possibile.

Vengono considerate solo le domande presentate tramite la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire:

• Lettera di copertura

(identificare una o più facoltà di interesse e fornire disponibilità)

• CV
(compreso un elenco classificato di almeno tre scrittori per lettere di riferimento)

• Dichiarazione di ricerca (copertura di interessi di ricerca, focus di ricerca passato e direzioni di ricerca future)

Ulteriori informazioni possono essere ottenute via e-mail a theory-postdoc@epfl.ch

(non sono considerate domande inviate a questo indirizzo)

· Data di inizio del contratto: 1 settembre 2027.

· Le sottomissioni saranno considerate fino al 28 febbraio 2027

Mission

Ihre Mission ist es, Forschung innerhalb der Theorie der Berechnungsgruppe an der EPFL durchzuführen. Spezifische Forschungsbereiche umfassen probabilistische Beweise, prägnante Argumente, kombinatorische Optimierung, Approximationsalgorithmen, Online-Algorithmen, sublineare Algorithmen, (Quanten-) Rechenkomplexität (Beweiskomplexität, Kommunikationskomplexität usw.), Quantenkryptographie, Algorithmen und Quantenlerntheorie.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Sie werden unabhängige Forschung innerhalb der Theoriegruppe durchführen. Sie haben einen großen Spielraum, um die Themen auszuwählen, die am besten zu Ihrem Profil und Interesse im Rahmen der Theoriegruppe passen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit PhD- und Master-Studenten zusammenzuarbeiten. Sie werden auch ermutigt, mit anderen Forschungsgruppen an der EPFL zusammenzuarbeiten, wann immer dies relevant ist.

Postdocs können zum Unterricht beitragen. Dies ist in der Regel nicht erforderlich, sollte aber mit dem Hosting-Professor besprochen werden, da die Anforderungen der Abteilung variieren.

Profil

• Jüngster Doktorand oder Postdoc

• Nachgewiesene wissenschaftliche Exzellenz in der theoretischen Informatik

• Starker Publikationsrekord

• Nachweis der Unabhängigkeit in der Forschung

• Führungsqualitäten und gute Integration in eine Forschungsgruppe

Wir bieten

Die EPFL hat ihren Sitz in Lausanne (Schweiz) und zählt zu den weltweit führenden wissenschaftlichen Universitäten. Im französischsprachigen Lausanne wird Englisch im Allgemeinen gut gesprochen und ist die Hauptsprache der EPFL. jobs.description:
Mission

The Molecular and Chemical Immunoengineering Group at EPFL develops molecular technologies to understand and engineer immune recognition and signaling. Our research combines protein engineering, chemical biology, molecular biology, and cell-based approaches to study T-cell recognition, post-translationally modified antigens, and synthetic immune-receptor signaling.

To support our expanding experimental program, we are seeking a motivated and experienced laboratory technician with strong expertise in mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays. The successful candidate will work closely with postdoctoral researchers and students across several projects and will play an important role in establishing robust and reproducible cell-based experimental workflows in the laboratory.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Mammalian cell culture: Maintain and expand mammalian cell lines, including routine culture, freezing, thawing, cell banking, and quality control.

• Cell-based assays: Perform routine signaling and functional assays, including stimulation experiments, dose-response and time-course assays, cell viability and proliferation measurements.

• Flow cytometry: Perform sample preparation, staining, acquisition, and basic analysis for flow cytometry and phospho-flow experiments.

• Cell engineering: Carry out transient transfection and lentiviral transduction and assist with the generation and maintenance of engineered stable cell lines.

• Primary immune-cell work: Assist with isolation, culture, stimulation, and analysis of primary human immune cells, particularly T cells, when required.

• Molecular biology support: Perform routine cloning, plasmid preparation, PCR, sequencing preparation, and related molecular biology procedures.

• Experimental support: Work closely with researchers to establish standardized protocols and perform routine or repeated experiments supporting ongoing research projects.

• Laboratory organization: Maintain cell stocks, reagents, inventories, and experimental records; assist with ordering and general laboratory organization.

• Safety and compliance: Ensure adherence to EPFL biosafety guidelines and laboratory procedures and contribute to maintaining a safe and well-organized working environment.

• Equipment maintenance: Assist with routine maintenance and coordination of servicing for relevant laboratory equipment.

Profile

Required qualifications

• BSc, MSc, CFC/EFZ, or equivalent training in biology, biotechnology, bioengineering, immunology, or a related life science field.

• At least two years of hands-on laboratory experience in an academic, clinical, or industrial research environment.

• Strong practical experience with mammalian cell culture.

• Experience with standard molecular and cell biology techniques.

• Experience with flow cytometry.

• Experience with viral transduction, transient transfection, and generation of stable cell lines.

• Careful and reproducible experimental work with excellent attention to detail.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple routine workflows in parallel.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with researchers in an international and multidisciplinary team.

• Good command of English.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience with isolation, thawing, culture, and handling of human PBMCs and primary T cells is a strong advantage.

• Experience with immune-cell activation, stimulation, and functional assays.

• Familiarity with phospho-flow cytometry or reporter cell systems.

• Experience with protein-based assays such as ELISA, Western blotting, or related biochemical techniques.

• Experience with molecular cloning and recombinant DNA techniques.

• Familiarity with automated or high-throughput experimental workflows.

• French language skills are an advantage but are not required.

We offer

• A stimulating position at one of the world’s leading research universities.

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment at the interface of molecular immunology, protein engineering, and chemical biology.

• The opportunity to contribute to multiple cutting-edge research projects in immune recognition and synthetic immune signaling.

• Close interaction with scientists from diverse backgrounds and access to EPFL’s state-of-the-art research and core facilities.

• Opportunities for professional development, including technical and language training courses.

• Family-friendly policies and flexible work arrangements supporting work–life balance.

Informations

Contract Start Date: As soon as possible (negotiable)

Activity Rate: 50–100% (negotiable)

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Workplace: EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland

Application materials: CV, short motivation letter, and contact information for 2–3 references

For additional information please contact: Dr. Aerin Yang (aerin.yang@epfl.ch)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Il Gruppo di Immunoingegneria molecolare e chimica dell'EPFL sviluppa tecnologie molecolari per comprendere e progettare il riconoscimento e la segnalazione immunitaria. La nostra ricerca combina l'ingegneria delle proteine, la biologia chimica, la biologia molecolare e gli approcci basati sulle cellule per studiare il riconoscimento delle cellule T, gli antigeni modificati post-traduttivamente e la segnalazione sintetica del ricevitore del sistema immunitario.

Per sostenere il nostro programma sperimentale in espansione, stiamo cercando un tecnico di laboratorio motivato ed esperto con una forte esperienza nella cultura cellulare dei mammiferi e saggi basati sulle cellule. Il candidato di successo lavorerà a stretto contatto con ricercatori e studenti post-dottorali in diversi progetti e svolgerà un ruolo importante nella creazione di flussi di lavoro sperimentali basati su cellule robuste e riproducibili in laboratorio.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

• Cultura cellulare mammifero: Mantenere ed espandere le linee cellulari dei mammiferi, tra cui la cultura di routine, il congelamento, il disgelo, il violoncello bancario e il controllo di qualità.

• Assaggi basati sulle cellule: Eseguire segnalazioni di routine e saggi funzionali, tra cui esperimenti di stimolazione, dosi-responsabilità e test di time-course, viabilità cellulare e misurazioni di proliferazione.

• Citometria di flusso: Eseguire la preparazione del campione, la colorazione, l'acquisizione e l'analisi di base per gli esperimenti di citometria di flusso e di flusso di fosforo.

• Ingegneria cellulare: Eseguire la trasfezione transitoria e la trasduzione lentivirale e assistere con la generazione e la manutenzione di linee cellulari stabili ingegnerizzate.

• Lavoro primario delle cellule immunitarie: Assistere con l'isolamento, la cultura, la stimolazione e l'analisi delle cellule immunitarie primarie umane, in particolare le cellule T, quando necessario.

• Supporto di biologia molecolare: Perform clonazione di routine, preparazione di plasmide, PCR, preparazione di sequenziamento e relative procedure di biologia molecolare.

• Supporto sperimentale: lavorare a stretto contatto con i ricercatori per stabilire protocolli standardizzati e eseguire esperimenti di routine o ripetuti che supportano i progetti di ricerca in corso.

• Organizzazione di laboratorio: Mantenere scorte di cellule, reagenti, inventori e registri sperimentali; assistere con ordinazione e organizzazione di laboratorio generale.

• Sicurezza e conformità: garantire l'adesione alle linee guida per la biosicurezza EPFL e alle procedure di laboratorio e contribuire a mantenere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e ben organizzato.

• Manutenzione attrezzature: Assistere con manutenzione ordinaria e coordinamento di manutenzione per attrezzature di laboratorio rilevanti.

Profilo

qualifiche richieste

• BSc, MSc, CFC/EFZ, o formazione equivalente in biologia, biotecnologia, bioingegneria, immunologia, o un campo di scienze della vita correlato.

• Almeno due anni di esperienza di laboratorio pratica in un ambiente di ricerca accademico, clinico o industriale.

• Forte esperienza pratica con la cultura cellulare mammifero.

• Esperienza con tecniche di biologia molecolare e cellulare standard.

• Esperienza con citometria di flusso.

• Esperienza con trasduzione virale, trasfezione transitoria e generazione di linee cellulari stabili.

• Lavoro sperimentale attento e riproducibile con un'ottima attenzione ai dettagli.

• Forte capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire più flussi di lavoro di routine in parallelo.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente collaborando a stretto contatto con i ricercatori in un team internazionale e multidisciplinare.

• Buon comando dell'inglese.

Desiderabili qualifiche

• L'esperienza con isolamento, scongelamento, cultura e gestione delle PBMC e delle cellule T primarie umane è un forte vantaggio.

• Esperienza con attivazione delle cellule immunitarie, stimolazione e saggi funzionali.

• Familiarità con citometria a flusso di fosforo o sistemi di cellule reporter.

• Esperienza con saggi a base di proteine come ELISA, Western blotting, o relative tecniche biochimiche.

• Esperienza con clonazione molecolare e tecniche di DNA ricombinante.

• Familiarità con flussi di lavoro sperimentali automatizzati o ad alto rendimento.

• Le competenze linguistiche francesi sono un vantaggio, ma non sono richieste.

Offriamo

• Una posizione stimolante in una delle principali università di ricerca del mondo.

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, internazionale e collaborativo all'interfaccia di immunologia molecolare, ingegneria delle proteine e biologia chimica.

• L'opportunità di contribuire a più progetti di ricerca all'avanguardia nel riconoscimento immunitario e nel segnale immunitario sintetico.

• Chiudi l’interazione con gli scienziati provenienti da diversi background e l’accesso alla ricerca e alle strutture di base dell’EPFL.

• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale, compresi i corsi di formazione tecnica e linguistica.

• Politiche a misura di famiglia e accordi di lavoro flessibili che sostengono l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita.

Informazioni

Data di inizio del contratto: appena possibile (negoziabile)

Tasso di attività: 50-100% (negoziabile)

Tipo di contratto: CDD

Durata: 1 anno, rinnovabile

Luogo di lavoro: EPFL, Lausanne, Svizzera

Materiali di applicazione: CV, lettera di motivazione breve e informazioni di contatto per 2-3 riferimenti

Per ulteriori informazioni rivolgersi a: Dr. Aerin Yang (aerin.yang@epfl.ch)

• Molecular biology support: Perform routine cloning, plasmid preparation, PCR, sequencing preparation, and related molecular biology procedures.

• Experimental support: Work closely with researchers to establish standardized protocols and perform routine or repeated experiments supporting ongoing research projects.

• Laboratory organization: Maintain cell stocks, reagents, inventories, and experimental records; assist with ordering and general laboratory organization.

• Safety and compliance: Ensure adherence to EPFL biosafety guidelines and laboratory procedures and contribute to maintaining a safe and well-organized working environment.

• Equipment maintenance: Assist with routine maintenance and coordination of servicing for relevant laboratory equipment.

Profile

Required qualifications

• BSc, MSc, CFC/EFZ, or equivalent training in biology, biotechnology, bioengineering, immunology, or a related life science field.

• Strong practical experience with mammalian cell culture.

• Experience with standard molecular and cell biology techniques.

• Experience with flow cytometry.

• Experience with viral transduction, transient transfection, and generation of stable cell lines.

• Careful and reproducible experimental work with excellent attention to detail.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple routine workflows in parallel.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with researchers in an international and multidisciplinary team.

• Good command of English.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience with immune-cell activation, stimulation, and functional assays.

• Familiarity with phospho-flow cytometry or reporter cell systems.

• Experience with protein-based assays such as ELISA, Western blotting, or related biochemical techniques.

• Experience with molecular cloning and recombinant DNA techniques.

• Familiarity with automated or high-throughput experimental workflows.

• French language skills are an advantage but are not required.

We offer

• A stimulating position at one of the world’s leading research universities.

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment at the interface of molecular immunology, protein engineering, and chemical biology.

• The opportunity to contribute to multiple cutting-edge research projects in immune recognition and synthetic immune signaling.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Die Molecular and Chemical Immunoengineering Group der EPFL entwickelt molekulare Technologien, um die Immunerkennung und -signalisierung zu verstehen und zu entwickeln. Unsere Forschung kombiniert Protein-Engineering, chemische Biologie, Molekularbiologie und zellbasierte Ansätze, um die Erkennung von T-Zellen, posttranslational modifizierte Antigene und synthetische Immunrezeptor-Signalisierung zu untersuchen.

Um unser expandierendes experimentelles Programm zu unterstützen, suchen wir einen motivierten und erfahrenen Labortechniker mit fundierter Expertise in Säugetierzellkultur und zellbasierten Assays. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird in mehreren Projekten eng mit Postdoktoranden und Studenten zusammenarbeiten und eine wichtige Rolle bei der Etablierung robuster und reproduzierbarer zellbasierter experimenteller Workflows im Labor spielen.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

• Säugetierzellkultur: Pflegen und erweitern Sie Säugetierzelllinien, einschließlich Routinekultur, Einfrieren, Auftauen, Zellbanking und Qualitätskontrolle.

• Zellbasierte Assays: Durchführung routinemäßiger Signalisierungs- und Funktionstests, einschließlich Stimulationsexperimenten, Dosis-Wirkungs- und Zeitverlaufstests, Zellviabilitäts- und Proliferationsmessungen.

• Durchflusszytometrie: Durchführung von Probenvorbereitung, Anfärbung, Erfassung und Grundanalyse für Durchflusszytometrie- und Phosphorflussexperimente.

• Cell Engineering: Durchführung von transienter Transfektion und lentiviraler Transduktion und Unterstützung bei der Erzeugung und Wartung von technischen stabilen Zelllinien.

• Primäre Immunzellenarbeit: Unterstützung bei Isolierung, Kultur, Stimulation und Analyse von primären menschlichen Immunzellen, insbesondere T-Zellen, wenn erforderlich.

• Molekularbiologische Unterstützung: Durchführung von Routineklonen, Plasmidpräparation, PCR, Sequenzierungspräparation und verwandten molekularbiologischen Verfahren.

• Experimentelle Unterstützung: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Forschern zusammen, um standardisierte Protokolle zu erstellen und Routine- oder wiederholte Experimente durchzuführen, die laufende Forschungsprojekte unterstützen.

• Labororganisation: Pflegen Sie Zellbestände, Reagenzien, Inventare und experimentelle Aufzeichnungen; Unterstützung bei der Bestellung und allgemeinen Labororganisation.

• Sicherheit und Compliance: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der EPFL-Richtlinien für biologische Sicherheit und Laborverfahren und Beitrag zur Aufrechterhaltung einer sicheren und gut organisierten Arbeitsumgebung.

• Wartung der Ausrüstung: Unterstützung bei der routinemäßigen Wartung und Koordination der Wartung der entsprechenden Laborausrüstung.

Profil

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• BSc, MSc, CFC / EFZ oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biotechnik, Immunologie oder einem verwandten Life-Science-Bereich.

• Mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Laborerfahrung in einer akademischen, klinischen oder industriellen Forschungsumgebung.

• Starke praktische Erfahrung mit Säugetier-Zellkultur.

• Erfahrung mit molekularen und zellbiologischen Standardtechniken.

• Erfahrung mit Durchflusszytometrie.

• Erfahrung mit viraler Transduktion, transienter Transfektion und Erzeugung stabiler Zelllinien.

• Sorgfältige und reproduzierbare experimentelle Arbeit mit exzellenter Liebe zum Detail.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Routine-Workflows parallel zu verwalten.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und eng mit Forschern in einem internationalen und multidisziplinären Team zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erwünschte Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung mit Isolation, Auftauen, Kultur und Umgang mit menschlichen PBMCs und primären T-Zellen ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit Immunzellaktivierung, Stimulation und funktionellen Assays.

• Vertrautheit mit Phosphor-Flow-Zytometrie- oder Reporterzellensystemen.

• Erfahrung mit proteinbasierten Assays wie ELISA, Western Blotting oder verwandten biochemischen Techniken.

Wir bieten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Le Groupe d'ingénierie moléculaire et chimique de l'EPFL développe des technologies moléculaires pour comprendre et concevoir la reconnaissance et la signalisation immunitaires. Nos recherches combinent l'ingénierie protéique, la biologie chimique, la biologie moléculaire et des approches basées sur les cellules pour étudier la reconnaissance des cellules T, les antigènes modifiés post-traductionnellement et la signalisation par récepteurs immunitaires synthétiques.

Pour appuyer notre programme expérimental en expansion, nous recherchons un technicien de laboratoire motivé et expérimenté possédant une solide expertise en culture cellulaire de mammifères et en essais cellulaires. Le candidat retenu travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des chercheurs postdoctoraux et des étudiants dans le cadre de plusieurs projets et jouera un rôle important dans l'établissement de flux de travail expérimentaux solides et reproductibles en laboratoire.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

• Culture cellulaire des mammifères : Maintenir et étendre les lignées cellulaires des mammifères, y compris la culture courante, le gel, le dégel, les banques cellulaires et le contrôle de la qualité.

• Tests à base de cellules : Effectuer des tests de signalisation et des tests fonctionnels de routine, y compris des expériences de stimulation, des essais dose-réponse et des tests de durée, des mesures de viabilité cellulaire et de prolifération.

• cytométrie de flux: Effectuer la préparation de l'échantillon, la coloration, l'acquisition et l'analyse de base pour les expériences de cytométrie de flux et de flux de phospho.

• Ingénierie cellulaire: Effectuer la transfection transitoire et la transduction lentivirale et aider à la génération et à l'entretien de lignées cellulaires stables.

• Travail sur les cellules immunitaires primaires : aide à l'isolement, à la culture, à la stimulation et à l'analyse des cellules immunitaires primaires humaines, en particulier des cellules T, au besoin.

• Soutien à la biologie moléculaire : Effectuer le clonage de routine, la préparation du plasmide, la PCR, la préparation du séquençage et les procédures de biologie moléculaire connexes.

• Soutien expérimental : Collaborer étroitement avec les chercheurs pour établir des protocoles normalisés et effectuer des expériences régulières ou répétées à l'appui de projets de recherche en cours.

• Organisation du laboratoire : tenir à jour les stocks de cellules, les réactifs, les inventaires et les dossiers expérimentaux; aider à commander et à organiser le laboratoire en général.

• Sécurité et conformité : Assurer le respect des directives de biosécurité et des procédures de laboratoire de l'EPFL et contribuer au maintien d'un environnement de travail sûr et bien organisé.

• Entretien de l'équipement : Aider à l'entretien de routine et à la coordination de l'entretien du matériel de laboratoire pertinent.

Profil

Compétences requises

• BSc, MSc, CFC/EFZ, ou formation équivalente en biologie, biotechnologie, bioingénierie, immunologie ou un domaine connexe des sciences de la vie.

• Au moins deux ans d'expérience pratique en laboratoire dans un milieu universitaire, clinique ou de recherche industrielle.

• Forte expérience pratique de la culture cellulaire des mammifères.

• Expérience des techniques de biologie moléculaire et cellulaire standard.

• Expérience de la cytométrie en flux.

• Expérience de la transduction virale, de la transfection transitoire et de la génération de lignées cellulaires stables.

• Travaux expérimentaux minutieux et reproductibles avec une excellente attention aux détails.

• Des compétences organisationnelles solides et la capacité de gérer plusieurs workflows de routine en parallèle.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en collaborant étroitement avec les chercheurs dans une équipe internationale et multidisciplinaire.

• Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais.

Qualifications souhaitables

• L'expérience de l'isolement, du dégel, de la culture et de la manipulation des PBMC humains et des cellules T primaires constitue un avantage important.

• Expérience de l'activation immunitaire, de la stimulation et des tests fonctionnels.

• Familiarité avec la cytométrie à flux de phospho ou avec les systèmes cellulaires des reporters.

• Expérience des essais à base de protéines tels que ELISA, Western blotting ou des techniques biochimiques connexes.

• Expérience des techniques de clonage moléculaire et d'ADN recombinant.

• Familiarité avec des workflows expérimentaux automatisés ou à haut débit.

• Les compétences en français sont un avantage, mais elles ne sont pas requises.

Nous offrons

• Une position stimulante dans l'une des grandes universités de recherche du monde.

• Un environnement de travail dynamique, international et collaboratif à l'interface de l'immunologie moléculaire, du génie protéique et de la biologie chimique.

• L'occasion de contribuer à de multiples projets de recherche de pointe en reconnaissance immunitaire et en signalisation immunitaire synthétique.

• Interaction étroite avec des scientifiques de divers horizons et accès à des installations de recherche et de base de pointe de l'EPFL.

• Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel, y compris des cours de formation technique et linguistique.

• Des politiques favorables à la famille et des modalités de travail souples favorisant l'équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle.

jobs.description:
Mission

Under the responsibility of the Dean of the School of Engineering (STI), you will be responsible for managing and coordinating the infrastructure activities of the faculty across its different sites.

You will ensure the smooth operation of STI infrastructure and associated services, coordinate renovation and laboratory installation projects, manage space allocation, and act as the main interface between STI research units, EPFL central services, and external partners.

You will lead the STI Infrastructure unit (STI-IN), supervise its activities, and provide practical solutions to technical and operational challenges in a dynamic academic and research environment.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Infrastructure Management and Coordination

• Oversee STI's daily infrastructure operations, including laboratories, shared facilities, scientific equipment logistics, and associated services.

• Act as the main contact for STI research units, coordinating infrastructure needs and technical solutions with EPFL central services and external partners.

• Renovation and Infrastructure Projects

• Manage laboratory renovations, modifications, and installations, from needs assessment to completion, ensuring compliance with budgets and deadlines.

• Coordinate infrastructure requirements for new professors, research groups, and shared scientific facilities.

• Space Management and Logistics

• Oversee space allocation, lead the STI Space Committee, and ensure implementation of its decisions.

• Coordinate laboratory relocations, reorganizations, closures, and scientific equipment transfers.

• Technical and Operational Support

• Assess technical issues and coordinate interventions, maintenance, and infrastructure improvements with EPFL technical services.

• Ensure effective resolution of operational issues and appropriate support to STI laboratories.

• Team Management and Institutional Support

• Lead the STI-IN team, coordinate operational priorities, and manage the unit's operating budget.

• Represent STI in infrastructure-related committees and support the Dean in institutional initiatives.

The position description is not exhaustive and may evolve according to institutional needs.

Profile

• Technical diploma (Technicien ES), engineering degree (Ingénieur HES), or equivalent education and experience in building technology, construction, or infrastructure management.

• Proven professional experience in building infrastructure management, renovation works, or technical project coordination.

• Good practical understanding of building systems and technical installations; experience with research laboratories is a strong asset.

• Experience in managing technical projects and coordinating multidisciplinary teams and service providers.

• Ability to assess technical needs, identify constraints, and propose practical and effective solutions.

• Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and ability to manage multiple projects and operational requests simultaneously.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proactive, pragmatic, and service-oriented approach.

• Proficiency with standard IT tools; knowledge of CAD software is an asset.

• Fluent in both French and English.

We offer

At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation.

We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference.

Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.

Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits

Informations

jobs.description:
About E4S

Launched in 2020, Enterprise for Society (E4S) is a joint initiative of EPFL , UNIL , and IMD , dedicated to bringing together the diverse strengths, expertise, and networks of the three institutions and to empowering society to overcome the major global challenges of our era (e.g., sustainable transition, disruptive technological change, geopolitical movements). By combining cutting-edge research, innovative teaching, and active engagement with industry and society, E4S aims to shape responsible leadership and impactful solutions to today’s global challenges.

Position Overview

E4S is seeking an experienced and dynamic Executive Director (100%, CDI) to lead its strategic and operational development. Reporting to the Academic Directors from the three partner institutions, the Executive Director will work in close collaboration with them and play a central role in refining and implementing the center’s strategy and ensuring its long-term success and impact.

While E4S is a joint center shared equally by the three partner institutions, the position of Executive Director is administratively based at EPFL , where the center is hosted. The Executive Director will work at EPFL’s campus in Lausanne.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic L eadership

• Execute and operationalise the strategic plan defined by the Academic Directors

• Drive the execution of the strategic roadmap and ensure alignment across the three institutions

• Operational Management

• Lead and inspire a dedicated, multidisciplinary team

• Oversee day-to-day operations and ensure efficient delivery of programs and initiatives

• Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong relationships within EPFL , UNIL , and IMD

• Develop and maintain partnerships with external stakeholders (corporate partners, foundations, public institutions)

• Lead fundraising efforts and identify new collaboration opportunities

• Steer and oversee internal events and external engagements, in line with the priorities set by the Academic Directors

• Education

• Coordinate the evolution of the Master’s in Sustainable Management and Technology (SMT)

• Coordinate the promotion of the SMT and increase its visibility

• Financial Oversight

• Oversee the center’s budget and financial planning

• Ensure sustainable resource allocation and reporting, in particular the annual activity report and annual financial statements to the E4S Supervisory Board

• Event Leadership

• Oversee the design and execution of E4S’s annual flagship event, the Showcase

• Strategically decide on which events to engage

• Ensure high visibility, strong participation, and alignment of any event with E4S’s mission

Profile and Qualifications

• Proven leadership experience in a senior management or executive role

• Strong strategic thinking combined with operational excellence

• Experience working across multiple stakeholders and institutions, including within multi-institutional governance structures, ideally in academic, public, or non-profit environments

• Familiarity with the Swiss higher-education landscape

• Understanding of higher-education settings, including the design and delivery of educational programmes (e.g., master’s programs)

• Demonstrated success in partnership development and fundraising

• Solid financial management skills

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences

• Familiarity with topics such as sustainability, disruptive technological changes and geopolitics is a strong asset

• A master’s degree (or equivalent) or a PhD

What We offer

• A unique leadership opportunity at the intersection of academia, business, and society

• A highly stimulating, international environment across three leading institutions

• The chance to shape a high-impact initiative addressing major global challenges

Informations

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: CDI

Reference: 2593

Interested candidates are invited to submit their application, including a CV and cover letter.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su E4S

Lanciata nel 2020, Enterprise for Society (E4S) è un'iniziativa congiunta di EPFL , UNIL e IMD , dedicata a riunire i diversi punti di forza, competenze e reti delle tre istituzioni e a rafforzare la società per superare le principali sfide globali della nostra epoca (ad esempio, transizione sostenibile, cambiamento tecnologico dirompente, movimenti geopolitici). Combinando la ricerca all'avanguardia, l'insegnamento innovativo e l'impegno attivo con l'industria e la società, E4S mira a plasmare la leadership responsabile e le soluzioni impattanti alle sfide globali di oggi.

Posizione Panoramica

E4S sta cercando un direttore esecutivo esperto e dinamico (100%, CDI) per condurre il suo sviluppo strategico e operativo. Segnalandosi ai Direttori Accademici delle tre istituzioni partner, il Direttore Esecutivo lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con loro e svolgerà un ruolo centrale nella raffinazione e nell’attuazione della strategia del centro e nella garanzia del suo successo e impatto a lungo termine.

Mentre E4S è un centro congiunto condiviso anche dalle tre istituzioni partner, la posizione di Executive Director è amministrativamente basata su EPFL , dove il centro è ospitato. Il direttore esecutivo lavorerà presso il campus di EPFL a Losanna.

Principali responsabilità

• L eadership strategica

• Esecuzione e operativizzazione del piano strategico definito dai Direttori Accademici

• Guidare l'esecuzione della roadmap strategica e garantire l'allineamento tra le tre istituzioni

• Gestione operativa

• Guida e ispira un team dedicato e multidisciplinare

• Superare le operazioni quotidiane e garantire la consegna efficiente di programmi e iniziative

• Stakeholder Engagement

• Costruire relazioni forti all'interno di EPFL , UNIL , e IMD

• Sviluppare e mantenere partnership con stakeholder esterni (partner aziendali, fondazioni, istituzioni pubbliche)

• Condurre gli sforzi di raccolta fondi e identificare nuove opportunità di collaborazione

• Promuovere e supervisionare gli eventi interni e gli impegni esterni, in linea con le priorità stabilite dai Direttori Accademici

• Istruzione

• Coordinare l’evoluzione del Master in Gestione e Tecnologia Sostenibile (SMT)

• Coordinare la promozione della SMT e aumentare la sua visibilità

• Supervisione finanziaria

• Superare il bilancio del centro e la pianificazione finanziaria

• Assicurare l'allocazione e la rendicontazione delle risorse sostenibili, in particolare la relazione annuale sull'attività e i rendiconti finanziari annuali al Consiglio di Sorveglianza E4S

• Leadership degli eventi

• Superare la progettazione e l'esecuzione dell'evento di punta annuale di E4S, la vetrina

• Decidere strategicamente su quali eventi impegnarsi

• Assicurare alta visibilità, forte partecipazione e allineamento di qualsiasi evento con la missione di E4S

Profilo e qualifiche

• Provata esperienza di leadership in un ruolo dirigenziale senior o esecutivo

• Forte pensiero strategico combinato con eccellenza operativa

• Esperienza di lavoro in più parti interessate e istituzioni, anche all'interno di strutture di governance multi-istituzionale, idealmente in ambienti accademici, pubblici o non-profit

• Familiarità con il paesaggio svizzero dell'istruzione superiore

• Comprensione delle impostazioni di istruzione superiore, compresa la progettazione e la consegna di programmi educativi (ad esempio, programmi di master)

• Successo dimostrativo nello sviluppo e nella raccolta fondi di partnership

• Competenze solide di gestione finanziaria

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di coinvolgere un pubblico diverso

• La familiarità con argomenti come la sostenibilità, i cambiamenti tecnologici dirompenti e la geopolitica è un bene forte

• Un master (o equivalente) o un dottorato

Cosa offriamo

• Un'opportunità di leadership unica all'incrocio tra accademia, affari e società

• Un ambiente internazionale altamente stimolante in tre principali istituzioni

• La possibilità di creare un'iniziativa ad alto impatto che affronti grandi sfide globali

Informazioni

Data di inizio del contratto: 01/15/2027

Tasso di attività: 100.00

Tipo di contratto: CDI

Riferimento: 2593

I candidati interessati sono invitati a presentare la loro domanda, tra cui un CV e una lettera di copertura.

jobs.description:
Mission

The South–North Laboratory for Sustainable Construction and Conservation (SONO Lab) at EPFL is recruiting a full-time PhD Student (100%) within the School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering (ENAC), based at the EPFL Fribourg associated campus.

SONO Lab investigates low-carbon, climate-responsive and socially inclusive approaches to building design, construction and conservation. Its research combines architectural design, environmental assessment, digital methods, full-scale experimentation, building-performance monitoring and participatory approaches, with a particular focus on collaborations between Europe and Africa.

The successful candidate will contribute to REGEN4BE—Regenerative Design for the Built Environment, a Horizon Europe project developed within the New European Bauhaus framework. REGEN4BE seeks to make regenerative design measurable, interoperable and scalable through digital tools, innovative materials, participatory processes, Living Labs and policy development. Its outputs include a Regenerative Evaluation Framework and the Regenerative Design Intelligence Platform (REDIP). Fribourg is one of the project’s European demonstration and replication sites.

Within REGEN4BE, the candidate will develop and scientifically validate interoperable digital workflows linking Building Information Modelling (BIM), Building Energy Modelling (BEM), Life-Cycle Assessment (LCA), embodied and operational carbon, circularity and material-reuse indicators, building monitoring, sensor data, Post-Occupancy Evaluation (PoE), and feedback from building operation into future design decisions.

The methods will be developed and tested through the REGEN4BE Fribourg demonstration activities, using Smart Living Lab data and infrastructure in close collaboration with the Building2050 team.

As an integrated strand of the doctoral thesis, the candidate will apply and adapt the REGEN4BE framework to selected earth-block and Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3)-based housing systems in African contexts. Building on SONO’s projects and partnerships, this research will examine how local materials, passive environmental strategies, construction processes, whole-life carbon, circularity, repairability, measured building performance and residents’ experience can inform regenerative design.

The European and African research strands will form one coherent doctoral project. The candidate will contribute to a generic interoperability framework within REGEN4BE and assess its transferability and necessary adaptation across different materials, climates, construction cultures and levels of digital infrastructure.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will take scientific responsibility for developing and completing your doctoral dissertation, formulate original research questions, and establish a rigorous methodology. You will conduct computational, experimental and field-based research in collaboration with academic, technical, institutional, software-development and industry partners. Your responsibilities will include collecting, managing, analysing and interpreting quantitative and qualitative data, preparing articles for peer-reviewed journals, presenting findings at conferences, workshops and project meetings, contributing to REGEN4BE deliverables, demonstrations and dissemination activities, and participating in teaching and, where appropriate, the supervision of student projects.

Within REGEN4BE, you will contribute to the development and scientific validation of the Regenerative Design Intelligence Platform (REDIP) and its building-data and performance-assessment workflows. You will develop and test interoperable methods linking BIM, openBIM and IFC with building-energy models, Life-Cycle Assessment, whole-life-carbon calculations, circularity indicators, monitoring data, occupant feedback and Post-Occupancy Evaluation. You will investigate data continuity, traceability, uncertainty and interoperability across the design, construction and operational phases of buildings, and define information requirements and data structures for exchanging geometry, materials, environmental indicators, measured performance and occupant feedback across digital environments.

You will establish protocols for assessing the reliability, accuracy, completeness, reproducibility and usability of the proposed workflows. Using Smart Living Lab datasets and infrastructure, you will undertake full-scale testing, data collection, model calibration and scientific validation in Fribourg. You will compare predicted and simulated performance with measured environmental conditions and occupant experience, and collaborate with Building2050, relevant EPFL laboratories and ENAC research platforms, including PL-MTI where applicable. You will also support the scientific specification, testing and validation of APIs, connectors, data pipelines and interfaces in coordination with the project’s software-development partners, and assess the transferability of the methods across REGEN4BE demonstration sites and different building, climatic and institutional contexts.

As part of the doctoral thesis, you will apply and adapt the REGEN4BE framework to selected SONO housing projects and partnerships in Africa. You will develop BIM information structures for earth blocks, compressed and stabilised-earth systems, LC3-based blocks, mortars, concrete components and related assemblies, incorporating locally specific material and construction data. You will investigate BIM-to-BEM workflows for passive environmental performance, including thermal mass, solar protection, natural ventilation, indoor air movement, temperature, humidity and occupant-controlled openings. You will also develop BIM-linked LCA, whole-life-carbon and circularity methods for locally produced, low-carbon and repairable construction, determine which methods are transferable and which require adaptation to local climatic, material, economic, technical and social conditions, and translate the findings into design recommendations and decision-support methods for climate-responsive and regenerative housing.

Profile

• A Master’s degree in architecture, architectural engineering, building science, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, computational design, environmental engineering, or a related field

• Strong interest in the intersection of architectural design, building technology, environmental performance, and digital methods

• Experience with BIM workflows and an interest in open, interoperable digital environments, including IFC

• Knowledge or experience in one or more of the following areas:
- building energy modelling and simulation;
- Life Cycle Assessment;
- embodied- and operational-carbon assessment;
- circular construction;
- building monitoring and Post-Occupancy Evaluation;
- computational design;
- building-data interoperability

• Strong data-analysis skills and the ability to work with heterogeneous datasets from digital models, simulations, environmental databases, sensors, surveys, and interviews

• Experience in scientific programming, scripting, or workflow automation. Knowledge of Python or an equivalent language is highly desirable

• Experience with APIs, databases, visual programming, parametric design, or data visualization is an asset.
Interest in earth construction, low-carbon cementitious systems, LC3, passive environmental design, and housing in African contexts

• Interest in full-scale experimentation, Living Labs, and the links between research, design, construction, building operation, and occupant experience

• Ability to conduct fieldwork and collaborate with researchers, professionals, contractors, institutions, communities, and residents

• Capacity to formulate original research questions, develop rigorous validation methods, and communicate findings through peer-reviewed scientific publications

• Excellent written and spoken English; French is an asset

• Scientific autonomy, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

We offer

• Four years to complete your PhD, with competitive remuneration according to EPFL employment conditions

• Membership in the EPFL Doctoral Program in Architecture and Sciences of the City—EDAR, subject to formal admission by the programme

• An opportunity to develop a distinctive scientific profile at the intersection of regenerative design, building-data interoperability, environmental simulation, whole-life-carbon assessment, circular construction, building monitoring and low-carbon materials

• Participation in a major international Horizon Europe consortium involving academic, public, technical, design and industry partners

• A world-class research and training environment with access to the Smart Living Lab, Building2050 expertise and relevant EPFL research infrastructure

• Opportunities for full-scale experimentation, international collaboration and field research connected to SONO’s projects and partnerships

• A multicultural and stimulating working environment at EPFL’s Fribourg associated campus

• A one-year fixed-term contract, renewable annually for a total planned duration of four years, subject to satisfactory progress and applicable EPFL employment conditions.

Informations

The doctoral candidate will be based at the South–North Laboratory for Sustainable Construction and Conservation—SONO Lab, within EPFL’s School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering, at the EPFL Fribourg associated campus. The thesis will be supervised by Prof. Aziza Chaouni.

The candidate will collaborate closely with, the REGEN4BE consortium; Smart Living Lab researchers and technical teams; Building2050; relevant EPFL laboratories and research platforms; SONO Lab’s academic and institutional partners in Africa; local researchers, professionals, construction partners, communities and building users involved in the selected case studies.

Application documents

Applications must include:

• A one-page motivation letter explaining your interest in the position and how your experience relates to the proposed research

• A detailed curriculum vitae, including your address, email and telephone number

• Copies of university diplomas and academic transcripts

• A research statement of no more than two pages outlining your relevant methodological experience and initial research interests

• One representative sample of relevant work, such as a publication, portfolio, thesis excerpt, research report, computational portfolio or technical project

• The names, affiliations and contact details of three referees willing to provide recommendations.

Please do not upload reference letters with the recruitment application. Only the referees’ names and contact details are required at this stage. They may later be contacted directly by the hiring manager. The separate EDAR application follows its own confidential recommendation procedure.

PhD application deadline: 1st October 2026
EDAR application deadline: 15 September 2026
Contract start date: 15 January 2027
Activity rate: 100%
Contract type: Fixed-term contract—CDD
Duration: Four years, from 15 January 2027 to 14 January 2031

For questions regarding the scientific content of the position, please contact aziza.chaouni@epfl.ch.

Applications must be submitted through the official EPFL recruitment platform. Applications sent by email will not be considered formal applications

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Il South-North Laboratory for Sustainable Construction and Conservation (SONO Lab) di EPFL sta reclutando un PhD Student a tempo pieno (100%) all'interno della School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering (ENAC), con sede presso il campus associato di EPFL Fribourg.

SONO Lab indaga gli approcci a basso tenore di carbonio, a risposta climatica e socialmente inclusi per la progettazione, la costruzione e la conservazione. La sua ricerca combina il design architettonico, la valutazione ambientale, i metodi digitali, la sperimentazione su larga scala, il monitoraggio delle prestazioni edilizie e gli approcci partecipativi, con particolare attenzione alle collaborazioni tra Europa e Africa.

Il candidato di successo contribuirà a REGEN4BE — Design rigenerativo per l'ambiente costruito, un progetto Horizon Europe sviluppato nell'ambito del nuovo quadro europeo Bauhaus. REGEN4BE cerca di rendere il design rigenerativo misurabile, interoperabile e scalabile attraverso strumenti digitali, materiali innovativi, processi partecipativi, Living Labs e sviluppo delle politiche. I suoi risultati includono un quadro di valutazione rigenerativa e la piattaforma di intelligence per il design rigenerativo (REDIP). Fribourg è uno dei siti europei di dimostrazione e replica del progetto.

All'interno di REGEN4BE, il candidato svilupperà e convalidarà scientificamente i flussi di lavoro digitali interoperabili che collegano Building Information Modelling (BIM), Building Energy Modelling (BEM), Life-Cycle Assessment (LCA), carbonio incorporato e operativo, indicatori di circolarità e di riutilizzo dei materiali, monitoraggio degli edifici, dati dei sensori, valutazione post-Occupancy (PoE), e feedback dall'operazione di costruzione alle future decisioni di progettazione.

I metodi saranno sviluppati e testati attraverso le attività dimostrative REGEN4BE Fribourg, utilizzando i dati e le infrastrutture Smart Living Lab in stretta collaborazione con il team Building2050.

Come filo integrato della tesi di dottorato, il candidato applicherà e adattarà il quadro REGEN4BE a blocchi terrestri selezionati e Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3)-based sistemi di alloggio in contesti africani. Sulla base dei progetti e dei partenariati di SONO, questa ricerca esaminerà come materiali locali, strategie ambientali passive, processi costruttivi, carbonio di vita intera, circolarità, riparabilità, prestazioni di costruzione misurate e l’esperienza dei residenti possano informare il design rigenerativo.

I settori della ricerca europea e africana costituiranno un progetto medico coerente. Il candidato contribuirà ad un generico quadro di interoperabilità all'interno di REGEN4BE e valuterà la sua trasferibilità e l'adattamento necessario in diversi materiali, climi, culture edili e livelli di infrastruttura digitale.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Come studente di dottorato, si assumerà la responsabilità scientifica per lo sviluppo e il completamento della vostra tesi di dottorato, formulare domande di ricerca originali, e stabilire una metodologia rigorosa. Condurrai ricerche computazionali, sperimentali e basate sul campo in collaborazione con partner accademici, tecnici, istituzionali, software-sviluppo e industria. Le tue responsabilità includono la raccolta, la gestione, l'analisi e l'interpretazione di dati quantitativi e qualitativi, la preparazione di articoli per riviste peer-reviewed, la presentazione dei risultati a conferenze, workshop e incontri di progetto, contribuendo a REGEN4BE consegnabili, dimostrazioni e attività di diffusione, e la partecipazione all'insegnamento e, se del caso, alla supervisione dei progetti studenteschi.

All'interno di REGEN4BE, contribuirai allo sviluppo e alla validazione scientifica della Piattaforma di Intelligenza del Design Rigenerativo (REDIP) e dei suoi flussi di lavoro di data ed esecuzione-valutazione. Svilupperai e testerai metodi interoperabili che collegano BIM, OpenBIM e IFC con modelli di costruzione-energia, valutazione del ciclo di vita, calcoli interi-vita-carbonio, indicatori di circolarità, dati di monitoraggio, feedback degli occupanti e valutazione post-Occupancy. Indagherete la continuità dei dati, la tracciabilità, l'incertezza e l'interoperabilità attraverso la progettazione, la costruzione e le fasi operative degli edifici, e definire i requisiti di informazione e le strutture dei dati per lo scambio di geometria, materiali, indicatori ambientali, prestazioni misurate e feedback degli occupanti in ambienti digitali.

Stabilirai protocolli per valutare l'affidabilità, l'accuratezza, la completezza, la riproducibilità e l'usabilità dei flussi di lavoro proposti. Utilizzando i dataset e le infrastrutture di Smart Living Lab, effettuerai test su larga scala, raccolta dati, calibrazione dei modelli e validazione scientifica a Fribourg. Potrai confrontare le prestazioni prevedibili e simulate con le condizioni ambientali misurate e l'esperienza occupante, e collaborare con Building2050, laboratori EPFL pertinenti e piattaforme di ricerca ENAC, tra cui PL-MTI, dove applicabile. Sosterrai anche le specifiche scientifiche, i test e la validazione di API, connettori, datadotti e interfacce in coordinamento con i partner di sviluppo software del progetto, e valuterai la trasferibilità dei metodi attraverso i siti dimostrativi REGEN4BE e diversi contesti costruttivi, climatici e istituzionali.

Nell'ambito della tesi di dottorato, si applica e si adatta il quadro REGEN4BE a progetti e partenariati SONO selezionati in Africa. Svilupperai strutture informative BIM per blocchi di terra, sistemi di terra compressi e stabilizzati, blocchi basati su LC3, mortai, componenti in calcestruzzo e assemblaggi correlati, incorporando materiali e dati di costruzione localmente specifici. Indagherete i flussi di lavoro BIM-to-BEM per le prestazioni ambientali passive, tra cui massa termica, protezione solare, ventilazione naturale, movimento dell'aria interna, temperatura, umidità e aperture controllate dagli occupanti. Svilupperai anche i metodi LCA, full-life-carbon e circolari per la costruzione localmente prodotta, a basso tenore di carbonio e riparabile, determinano quali metodi sono trasferibili e che richiedono l'adattamento alle condizioni climatiche, materiali, economiche, tecniche e sociali locali, e traducono i risultati in raccomandazioni di progettazione e metodi di supporto decisionale per l'alloggio responsabile e rigenerativo del clima.

Profilo

• Laurea Magistrale in architettura, ingegneria architettonica, scienze della costruzione, ingegneria civile, ingegneria meccanica, progettazione computazionale, ingegneria ambientale, o un campo correlato

• Forte interesse per l'intersezione di progettazione architettonica, tecnologia di costruzione, prestazioni ambientali e metodi digitali

• Esperienza con flussi di lavoro BIM e interesse per ambienti digitali aperti e interoperabili, tra cui IFC

• Conoscenza o esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree:
- costruzione di modelli di energia e simulazione;
- Valutazione del ciclo di vita;
- valutazione corporea e operativa-carbonio;
- costruzione circolare;
- monitoraggio della costruzione e valutazione post-operatoria;
- progettazione computazionale;
- interoperabilità dei dati

• Forte capacità di analisi dei dati e la capacità di lavorare con dataset eterogenei da modelli digitali, simulazioni, database ambientali, sensori, sondaggi e interviste

• Esperienza nella programmazione scientifica, scrittura o automazione del flusso di lavoro. La conoscenza di Python o di un linguaggio equivalente è altamente auspicabile

• Esperienza con API, database, programmazione visiva, progettazione parametrica o visualizzazione dei dati è un bene.
Interessi nella costruzione della terra, sistemi cementizi a basso tenore di carbonio, LC3, progettazione ambientale passiva e alloggiamento in contesti africani

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

The South–North Laboratory for Sustainable Construction and Conservation (SONO Lab) at EPFL is recruiting a full-time PhD Student (100%) within the School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering (ENAC), based at the EPFL Fribourg associated campus.

SONO Lab investigates low-carbon, climate-responsive and socially inclusive approaches to building design, construction and conservation. Its research combines architectural design, environmental assessment, digital methods, full-scale experimentation, building-performance monitoring and participatory approaches, with a particular focus on collaborations between Europe and Africa.

The successful candidate will contribute to REGEN4BE—Regenerative Design for the Built Environment, a Horizon Europe project developed within the New European Bauhaus framework. REGEN4BE seeks to make regenerative design measurable, interoperable and scalable through digital tools, innovative materials, participatory processes, Living Labs and policy development. Its outputs include a Regenerative Evaluation Framework and the Regenerative Design Intelligence Platform (REDIP). Fribourg is one of the project’s European demonstration and replication sites.

Within REGEN4BE, the candidate will develop and scientifically validate interoperable digital workflows linking Building Information Modelling (BIM), Building Energy Modelling (BEM), Life-Cycle Assessment (LCA), embodied and operational carbon, circularity and material-reuse indicators, building monitoring, sensor data, Post-Occupancy Evaluation (PoE), and feedback from building operation into future design decisions.

The methods will be developed and tested through the REGEN4BE Fribourg demonstration activities, using Smart Living Lab data and infrastructure in close collaboration with the Building2050 team.

As an integrated strand of the doctoral thesis, the candidate will apply and adapt the REGEN4BE framework to selected earth-block and Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3)-based housing systems in African contexts. Building on SONO’s projects and partnerships, this research will examine how local materials, passive environmental strategies, construction processes, whole-life carbon, circularity, repairability, measured building performance and residents’ experience can inform regenerative design.

The European and African research strands will form one coherent doctoral project. The candidate will contribute to a generic interoperability framework within REGEN4BE and assess its transferability and necessary adaptation across different materials, climates, construction cultures and levels of digital infrastructure.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will take scientific responsibility for developing and completing your doctoral dissertation, formulate original research questions, and establish a rigorous methodology. You will conduct computational, experimental and field-based research in collaboration with academic, technical, institutional, software-development and industry partners. Your responsibilities will include collecting, managing, analysing and interpreting quantitative and qualitative data, preparing articles for peer-reviewed journals, presenting findings at conferences, workshops and project meetings, contributing to REGEN4BE deliverables, demonstrations and dissemination activities, and participating in teaching and, where appropriate, the supervision of student projects.

Within REGEN4BE, you will contribute to the development and scientific validation of the Regenerative Design Intelligence Platform (REDIP) and its building-data and performance-assessment workflows. You will develop and test interoperable methods linking BIM, openBIM and IFC with building-energy models, Life-Cycle Assessment, whole-life-carbon calculations, circularity indicators, monitoring data, occupant feedback and Post-Occupancy Evaluation. You will investigate data continuity, traceability, uncertainty and interoperability across the design, construction and operational phases of buildings, and define information requirements and data structures for exchanging geometry, materials, environmental indicators, measured performance and occupant feedback across digital environments.

You will establish protocols for assessing the reliability, accuracy, completeness, reproducibility and usability of the proposed workflows. Using Smart Living Lab datasets and infrastructure, you will undertake full-scale testing, data collection, model calibration and scientific validation in Fribourg. You will compare predicted and simulated performance with measured environmental conditions and occupant experience, and collaborate with Building2050, relevant EPFL laboratories and ENAC research platforms, including PL-MTI where applicable. You will also support the scientific specification, testing and validation of APIs, connectors, data pipelines and interfaces in coordination with the project’s software-development partners, and assess the transferability of the methods across REGEN4BE demonstration sites and different building, climatic and institutional contexts.

As part of the doctoral thesis, you will apply and adapt the REGEN4BE framework to selected SONO housing projects and partnerships in Africa. You will develop BIM information structures for earth blocks, compressed and stabilised-earth systems, LC3-based blocks, mortars, concrete components and related assemblies, incorporating locally specific material and construction data. You will investigate BIM-to-BEM workflows for passive environmental performance, including thermal mass, solar protection, natural ventilation, indoor air movement, temperature, humidity and occupant-controlled openings. You will also develop BIM-linked LCA, whole-life-carbon and circularity methods for locally produced, low-carbon and repairable construction, determine which methods are transferable and which require adaptation to local climatic, material, economic, technical and social conditions, and translate the findings into design recommendations and decision-support methods for climate-responsive and regenerative housing.

Profile

• A Master’s degree in architecture, architectural engineering, building science, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, computational design, environmental engineering, or a related field

• Strong interest in the intersection of architectural design, building technology, environmental performance, and digital methods

• Experience with BIM workflows and an interest in open, interoperable digital environments, including IFC

• Knowledge or experience in one or more of the following areas:
- building energy modelling and simulation;
- Life Cycle Assessment;
- embodied- and operational-carbon assessment;
- circular construction;
- building monitoring and Post-Occupancy Evaluation;
- computational design;
- building-data interoperability

• Strong data-analysis skills and the ability to work with heterogeneous datasets from digital models, simulations, environmental databases, sensors, surveys, and interviews

• Experience in scientific programming, scripting, or workflow automation. Knowledge of Python or an equivalent language is highly desirable

• Experience with APIs, databases, visual programming, parametric design, or data visualization is an asset.
Interest in earth construction, low-carbon cementitious systems, LC3, passive environmental design, and housing in African contexts

• Interest in full-scale experimentation, Living Labs, and the links between research, design, construction, building operation, and occupant experience

• Ability to conduct fieldwork and collaborate with researchers, professionals, contractors, institutions, communities, and residents

• Capacity to formulate original research questions, develop rigorous validation methods, and communicate findings through peer-reviewed scientific publications

• Excellent written and spoken English; French is an asset

• Scientific autonomy, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

We offer

• Four years to complete your PhD, with competitive remuneration according to EPFL employment conditions

• Membership in the EPFL Doctoral Program in Architecture and Sciences of the City—EDAR, subject to formal admission by the programme

• An opportunity to develop a distinctive scientific profile at the intersection of regenerative design, building-data interoperability, environmental simulation, whole-life-carbon assessment, circular construction, building monitoring and low-carbon materials

• Participation in a major international Horizon Europe consortium involving academic, public, technical, design and industry partners

• A world-class research and training environment with access to the Smart Living Lab, Building2050 expertise and relevant EPFL research infrastructure

• Opportunities for full-scale experimentation, international collaboration and field research connected to SONO’s projects and partnerships

• A multicultural and stimulating working environment at EPFL’s Fribourg associated campus

• A one-year fixed-term contract, renewable annually for a total planned duration of four years, subject to satisfactory progress and applicable EPFL employment conditions.

Informations

The doctoral candidate will be based at the South–North Laboratory for Sustainable Construction and Conservation—SONO Lab, within EPFL’s School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering, at the EPFL Fribourg associated campus. The thesis will be supervised by Prof. Aziza Chaouni.

The candidate will collaborate closely with, the REGEN4BE consortium; Smart Living Lab researchers and technical teams; Building2050; relevant EPFL laboratories and research platforms; SONO Lab’s academic and institutional partners in Africa; local researchers, professionals, construction partners, communities and building users involved in the selected case studies.

Application documents

Applications must include:

• A one-page motivation letter explaining your interest in the position and how your experience relates to the proposed research

• A detailed curriculum vitae, including your address, email and telephone number

• Copies of university diplomas and academic transcripts

• A research statement of no more than two pages outlining your relevant methodological experience and initial research interests

• One representative sample of relevant work, such as a publication, portfolio, thesis excerpt, research report, computational portfolio or technical project

• The names, affiliations and contact details of three referees willing to provide recommendations.

Please do not upload reference letters with the recruitment application. Only the referees’ names and contact details are required at this stage. They may later be contacted directly by the hiring manager. The separate EDAR application follows its own confidential recommendation procedure.
